knowledge: If the ECU detects that the difference between the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor and the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal exceeds the set maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Clutch Position Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The clutch position sensor transmits information about whether the clutch is depressed in the form of an electrical signal to the electronic control unit, which serves as an important parameter for controlling engine start and cruise control systems.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch E Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Exhaust Pressure Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The exhaust pressure sensor is used to transmit the exhaust system pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the ECU detects an error in the exhaust pressure sensor A circuit voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Sensor Reference Voltage B Circuit/Open
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected an error in the 5V reference voltage circuit B. Causes of the fault include a short circuit or open circuit from the 5V reference voltage circuit to a sensor, a short circuit or open circuit in one or more sensors, an automatic transmission hydraulic sensor fault, a solenoid valve fault, a transmission control module fault, a transmission input speed (RPM) sensor fault, a transmission output speed (RPM) sensor fault, etc.

des: Drive Motor A Inverter Phase W Over Temperature
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Control Module Processor
knowledge: An error has occurred in the electronic control unit (ECU). This fault code may also be caused by the modification of non-original parts. After this fault code appears, delete it first to see if it will appear again. If it appears again soon, in most cases it means that the electronic control module needs to be replaced.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense B Circuit High
Upshift/Skip Shift Lamp Control Circuit
knowledge: For some high-power cars, in order to improve the fuel efficiency and reduce emissions, when the conditions are met (low speed, low throttle, car preheated, etc.), the shift solenoid valve will prevent the 2nd and 3rd gears from being engaged, which is equivalent to forcing the gear lever to shift directly from 1st gear to 4th gear. At this time, the shift indicator light will light up. P0804 shows that the shift indicator light control circuit is faulty.

des: Cylinder 8 Glow Plug Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 8 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 4 Glow Plug Incorrect
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that there is an error in the cylinder 4 glow plug, its circuit, connector, or the glow plug control module (GPCM).

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 2, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value. Fault causes include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Cylinder 10 Glow Plug Control Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 10 glow plug control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Positive Crankcase Ventilation Filter Restriction
knowledge: The function of the crankcase positive ventilation (PCV) system is to guide the blowby gas in the crankcase (at the end of the engine's combustion process, some unburned mixture leaks from the piston ring into the crankcase under high pressure, and the industry calls this leakage blowby gas) into the intake manifold through the vacuum generated by the engine. Then the blowby gas will enter the cylinder together with the fresh air and burn, thereby reducing pollution and improving engine efficiency. This fault code indicates that the crankcase positive ventilation system filter is blocked.

des: Cylinder 8 Injector Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the 8th cylinder injector control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Fan 2 Control Circuit
knowledge: This fault code will appear if the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the high-speed fan control circuit still has significant current consumption when it is grounded (fan on); or when the high-speed fan control circuit is not grounded (fan off) and no voltage is detected.

des: Air Assisted Injector Control Range/Performance
knowledge: The air-assisted fuel injector makes the sprayed gasoline mist finer by introducing high-pressure air into the fuel injection passage, thereby optimizing gasoline combustion. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the air-assisted fuel injector control circuit is out of the normal calibrated range, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include faults in the air-assisted fuel injector solenoid valve itself or its circuit, oxygen sensor fault, or powertrain control module (PCM) fault, etc.

des: Cylinder 4 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector circuit of the 4th cylinder, this fault code will appear.

des: Mass or Volume Air Flow B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects an error in the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, this fault code will appear.

des: Intake Air Heater A Circuit
knowledge: The intake air heater, also called the manifold intake air heater, is used to preheat the intake air to help the diesel engine start easily in cold weather. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected that the manifold intake air heater circuit (MIAH) circuit voltage exceeds the calibrated normal value.

des: Four Wheel Drive (4WD) Switch Circuit Range/Performance
Generator Voltage Sense Circuit Low
knowledge: The generator voltage monitoring circuit is used to transmit the generator voltage signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) as a reference for controlling the charging speed and determining whether the generator is working properly. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected an error in the generator voltage monitoring circuit. The causes of the fault include the generator voltage monitoring circuit, the generator, or the ECU.

des: Drive Motor B Temperature Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The temperature sensor circuit of the drive motor B is faulty. The causes of the fault include the circuit, connector, electronic control unit, drive motor, etc. The drive motor temperature sensor of some vehicles is integrated with the drive motor. Therefore, if it is determined that the problem is with the temperature sensor itself, it may be necessary to replace the entire drive motor.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation A Flow
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. The electronic control unit (ECU) monitors the working condition of the exhaust gas recirculation system (EGR) in each driving cycle. When the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) flow rate is too high or too low than the estimated value based on other information, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include EGR connector, circuit fault, EGR valve fault itself, manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor fault, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault.

des: HO2S Heater Resistance (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the number of oxygen sensors in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code indicates that the current of the heated oxygen sensor heater control circuit is too low or too high.

des: Engine Shutoff Solenoid
knowledge: The engine fuel cut-off solenoid valve, its circuit, connector, or electronic control unit is faulty.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Over Temperature
knowledge: The control module has detected that the hybrid battery pack is in an overtemperature condition.

des: Fuel Trim (Bank 1)
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, while too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. Causes include air leaks after the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, PCV system leaks, exhaust leaks near or before the oxygen sensor, clogged injectors or other fuel system malfunctions, EGR system leaks, contaminated MAF sensors (causing the ECU to underestimate air flow), low fuel tank level, or an oil dipstick that is not properly seated.

des: Reverse Output Circuit
knowledge: The electronic control unit (ECU) found that the reverse gear switch signal did not change when the reverse gear was engaged and disengaged.

des: Cylinder 7 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Max Limit
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the compensation learning of the 7th cylinder injector has reached the maximum learning limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Clutch Actuator Circuit Low
knowledge: The clutch actuator is the executor of the clutch action. Its basic function is to separate and engage the clutch. The electromechanical clutch actuator uses the electric motor as the power source and controls the speed and position to achieve precise adjustment of the clutch engagement process.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense P Circuit
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Internal Control Module Coolant Temperature Performance
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components. The engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor transmits the temperature of the engine coolant to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal through the principle of thermistor, as a basis for correcting injection and ignition.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch B Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Drive Motor B Phase UVW Circuit Low
Pressure Control Solenoid C
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or control module, etc.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1 or Single Sensor)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. This fault code indicates that the A (intake/left/front) camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit is wrong. The causes of the fault include the camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit, connector, its own fault, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the drive motor A position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid drive motor; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Transmission Friction Element D Performance/Stuck Off
Fuel Temperature Too High
knowledge: The fuel temperature sensor is responsible for monitoring the temperature of the fuel leading to the fuel pump to avoid vapor lock caused by excessive temperature (120 degrees Celsius), which may cause damage to the fuel pump or injector. This fault code indicates that the fuel temperature is higher than the maximum allowable value within a set period of time.

des: Cylinder 9 Glow Plug Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 9 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine heat up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery C Voltage Low
TCU Power Relay Sense Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the engine control module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. The function of the control module relay is to continue to keep the control module powered after the ignition switch is turned off until the control module completes the shutdown process.

des: Generator Current Sensor Circuit High
Charge Air Cooler Coolant Pump Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. If the voltage of the coolant pump control circuit of the charge air cooler is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit (Bank 1, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) monitors the circuit of the heated oxygen sensor. When the ECU detects a problem with the circuit used to measure the oxygen content in the exhaust gas, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Inverter Voltage Too High
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Timing Reference High Resolution Signal B Too Many Pulses
knowledge: The optical sensor provides a high-resolution signal to the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) by counting the pulses on the sensor disk located inside the injection pump. This signal is one of the important references for the PCM to control fuel and timing. The causes of this fault code include the optical sensor, its circuit, connector or PCM.

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor D Circuit High
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: B Camshaft Position Slow Response (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft regulating valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. The causes of P000B include the exhaust/right/rear camshaft regulating valve (oil control valve), its circuit, connector, dirty oil or ECU.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch E Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Cylinder 7 Injector Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the injector opening time interval (also called pulse width). If the voltage of the 7th cylinder injector control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Sensor - Circuit Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial momentum of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. This fault code indicates that the circuit voltage of the inlet pressure sensor (downstream of the throttle valve) is lower than the minimum calibration value (0.25 volts). This fault code may be a problem with the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor for some vehicles.

des: B Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valve. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. The causes of P0025 include B exhaust/right/rear camshaft timing is not set properly, the camshaft is mechanically stuck due to the principle of over-advance, or the actuator valve is stuck in the open position.

des: Gear Lever Y Position Circuit Intermittent
Drive Motor B Phase UVW Current Sensor Correlation
Fuel Temperature Sensor B Circuit High
knowledge: The fuel temperature sensor is responsible for monitoring the temperature of the fuel going to the fuel pump to avoid vapor lock caused by excessive temperature (120 degrees Celsius), which may damage the fuel pump or injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the fuel temperature sensor signal voltage. If this voltage is higher than the maximum calibrated value (4.5 volts or -43 degrees Celsius) for a set period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor E Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Ignition Coil A Primary/Secondary Circuit
knowledge: The function of the ignition coil is to convert the 12 volt voltage of the car battery into thousands or even tens of thousands of volts required for spark plug ignition. There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include ignition start/run circuit, ignition coil circuit, ignition coil itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 8 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Max Limit
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the compensation learning of the 8th cylinder injector has reached the maximum learning limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Clutch Pedal Switch B Circuit
knowledge: The function of the clutch pedal switch is to transmit the information of whether the clutch is pressed to the electronic control unit in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as an important parameter for controlling the engine start and cruise control system.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense U Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch F Circuit
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Hybrid Battery System Voltage
Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The fan motor controller is responsible for regulating the voltage of the hybrid battery pack cooling fan. If the cooling fan 1 control circuit voltage falls below the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 6 Glow Plug Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 6 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Phase W Current Low
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the generator inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The exhaust pressure sensor is used to transmit the exhaust system pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the ECU detects a sudden change in the voltage of the exhaust pressure sensor A signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Inverter Phase U Over Temperature
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B Position Sensor/Switch Circuit
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage exceeds the calibrated normal value, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Vent Control Circuit
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. This fault code appears if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the evaporative emissions system ventilation solenoid valve control circuit voltage is out of the normal calibration range.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor B Circuit High (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. This fault code indicates that the signal voltage of the B (exhaust/right/rear) camshaft position (CMP) sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The causes of the fault include the camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit, connector, its own fault, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor B Circuit High (Bank 2)

In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the camshaft sensor B circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit, connector, its own fault, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Cruise Control Servo Control Circuit High

This fault code indicates that the voltage of the cruise control system servo control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The causes of the fault include the servo control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor/Switch High
knowledge: The function of the oil pressure sensor is to transmit the oil pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the pressure is insufficient, the ECU will issue an alarm signal on the dashboard. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the oil pressure sensor signal voltage is higher than 4.9 volts, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the oil pressure sensor, its circuit, connector, and electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Pressure Control Solenoid B Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. The causes of this fault code include the pressure control solenoid valve itself, the circuit, the connector, etc. At the same time, it should be noted that in some cases, the failure of the transmission control solenoid valve is not due to electronic problems, but due to pipeline blockage or mechanical problems. Many times, many such failures are caused simply because the transmission oil is too dirty.

des: Cylinder 2 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the circuit of the 2nd cylinder injector, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Control Circuit Range/Performance

When the generator is required to run, the ECU sends a 5V signal to the voltage regulator through the generator start signal circuit. After receiving this signal, the voltage regulator will start to control the generator field circuit. If the fault detection circuit finds that the generator start circuit voltage is incorrect, this fault code will appear. The voltage regulator may also detect an error and display this fault code. The cause of the fault includes the generator, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit.

des: PCM/ECM/TCU Internal Temperature Sensor A Circuit Low
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and transmission control module on some cars are integrated into the powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Another important function is to monitor the components responsible for exhaust emission control. The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the engine control module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the temperature sensor signal circuit inside the control module is lower than the calibrated minimum value. The cause of the fault is the internal temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or control module.

Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if the adaptive fuel control system has reached its compensation limit and the air-fuel ratio is still rich. Causes include intake air flow sensor or manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor failure, high fuel pressure, fuel pressure regulator failure, injector failure, oxygen sensor failure, camshaft timing error, oil overfill, evaporative emission system error, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The boost pressure sensor, also called the boost pressure sensor (BPS), transmits the boost pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. des: TCU Power Relay Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the engine control module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. The function of the control module relay is to continue to keep the control module powered after the ignition switch is turned off until the control module completes the shutdown process.

des: Fuel Pump Module Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The fuel pump control module (FPM, or FPCM) is a computer microprocessor that controls the voltage to the fuel pump (usually located in the fuel tank) in order to achieve the optimal fuel pressure required by the electronic control module (ECU).

des: Warm Up Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the efficiency of the catalytic converter system is lower than the acceptable minimum value before reaching the operating temperature. The causes of the fault include exhaust manifold or exhaust pipe leakage, catalytic converter failure, engine coolant temperature (ECT) or cylinder head temperature (CHT) sensor failure, engine misfire or ignition timing is too delayed, engine oil is too dirty, front or rear oxygen sensor failure, fuel system pressure is too high, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense W Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Fuel Pump Control Module Requested MIL Illumination
knowledge: The fuel pump control module (FPM, or FPCM) is a computer microprocessor that controls the voltage to the fuel pump (usually located in the fuel tank) to achieve the optimal fuel pressure required by the electronic control module (ECU). The malfunction indicator light (MIL), also known as the check engine light, illuminates a yellow or red engine symbol on the dashboard when the control module detects a malfunction. Fault causes include the fuel pump, fuel pump control module (FPCM), circuits, connectors, electronic control unit (ECU), etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense N Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: TCU Power Input Signal Intermittent
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, allowing the vehicle to improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense N Circuit
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: ECM/PCM Power Relay De-Energized Performance - Too Late
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the components for exhaust emission control. The function of the engine control module relay is to continue to maintain the power supply to the engine control module after the ignition switch is turned off until the engine control module completes the shutdown process.

des: Fuel Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The fuel temperature sensor is responsible for monitoring the temperature of the fuel going to the fuel pump to avoid vapor lock caused by excessive temperature (120 degrees Celsius), which may damage the fuel pump or injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the fuel temperature sensor signal voltage. If this voltage is higher than the maximum calibrated value (4.5 volts or -43 degrees Celsius) for a set period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Hydraulic Pump Relay Circuit High
Sensor Reference Voltage D Circuit Low
knowledge: The electronic control unit (ECU) has detected an error in the 5 volt reference voltage circuit D. The causes of the fault include a short circuit or short circuit from the 5 volt reference voltage circuit to a certain sensor, a short circuit or open circuit in one or more sensors, the ECU, etc.

des: Air Assisted Injector Control Circuit High
knowledge: The air-assisted fuel injector makes the sprayed gasoline mist finer by introducing high-pressure air into the fuel injection channel, thereby optimizing gasoline combustion. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the air-assisted fuel injector control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include faults in the air-assisted fuel injector solenoid valve itself or its circuit, oxygen sensor fault, or powertrain control module (PCM) fault, etc.

des: System Voltage High
knowledge: The ECU has detected that the system voltage is continuously above 16 volts for up to 5 seconds. Causes include alternator failure, voltage regulator failure, etc.

des: Generator Position Sensor Circuit A Range/Performance
Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Current
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Temperature Too Low
Crankshaft Position Sensor B Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The crankshaft position (CKP) sensor (also called the top dead center sensor) detects the top dead center (TDC) signal, crank angle signal and engine speed signal, and inputs them into the computer, so that the computer can issue the best ignition timing instruction according to the ignition sequence of the cylinders. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the crankshaft sensor B circuit voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 5 Glow Plug Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 5 glow plug circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery System Voltage Unstable
Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

des: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Rich to Lean (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate of the oxygen sensor signal during the rise and fall process. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that an acceptable voltage change rate is not detected during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from rich to lean, this fault code will appear.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate Solenoid A Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the wastegate solenoid valve is to adjust the turbine speed and thus the maximum boost pressure by controlling the exhaust gas flow entering the turbine (bypassing the rest of the exhaust gas). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the wastegate solenoid valve A circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Throttle Control Circuit A /Open
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust gas recirculation sensor A signal voltage is out of the calibrated normal range, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected (very small leak)
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chamber. If the electronic control module detects a leak less than 0.04 inches in diameter, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include loose fuel tank cap, leaking evaporative emission system pipes, evaporative emission system gasket gap, and the charcoal canister vent (CV) solenoid valve is not closed tightly.

des: Vehicle Speed Sensor A Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the vehicle speed sensor (VSS) is to transmit the speed of the car to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for controlling engine idle speed, automatic transmission shifting, torque converter lock, engine cooling fan opening and closing, cruise control and other functions. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the vehicle speed signal circuit is too low, this fault code will appear.

des: PTO Control Module
knowledge: PTO is short for power take-off. It usually refers to the device that provides power to additional components. Fault causes include accessory power take-off (PTO) control module, circuits, connectors, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch C Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the throttle pedal position sensor C circuit voltage exceeds the normal range when the throttle is closed or fully open.

des: Sensor Reference Voltage B Circuit Low
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected an error in the 5V reference voltage circuit B. Causes of the fault include a short circuit or open circuit from the 5V reference voltage circuit to a sensor, a short circuit or open circuit in one or more sensors, an automatic transmission hydraulic sensor fault, a solenoid valve fault, a transmission control module fault, a transmission input speed (RPM) sensor fault, a transmission output speed (RPM) sensor fault, etc.

des: Cylinder 10 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Min Limit
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the compensation learning of the 10th cylinder injector has reached the minimum learning limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The exhaust pressure sensor is used to transmit the exhaust system pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the ECU detects that the exhaust pressure sensor A signal circuit voltage is higher than 4.95 volts within a set period of time (2.5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor C Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) sensor signal voltage is wrong, this fault code will appear.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Supply Voltage Circuit High
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the turbo/supercharger boost control A power supply voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value.

des: Fuel Pump Module Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The fuel pump control module (FPM, or FPCM) is a computer microprocessor that controls the voltage to the fuel pump (usually located in the fuel tank) in order to achieve the optimal fuel pressure required by the electronic control module (ECU).

des: Internal Control Module Throttle Position Performance
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the components responsible for exhaust emission control. In the electronic throttle (ETC) system, the electronic control module (ECU) instructs the throttle position motor to achieve the best throttle opening based on the signal from the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor and the engine speed, vehicle speed, air conditioning energy consumption, etc. The function of the throttle position (TP) sensor is to transmit the throttle opening to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal as one of the basic parameters for controlling engine fuel injection.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Bypass Valve Control Circuit Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the supercharger bypass valve is to open the bypass valve to release part of the high-pressure air when the boost pressure is too high, thereby protecting the supercharger and the engine. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the turbine/supercharger bypass valve control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value.

des: Engine Failed to Start
knowledge: It may be a problem with the electronic control unit (ECU) and the sequential multi-channel injection system (SFI).

des: Cylinder 12 Injector Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the 12th cylinder injector control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Cylinder 6 Glow Plug Control Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 6 glow plug circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid C Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 7 - Fuel Trim at Max Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the maximum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Gear 3 Incorrect Ratio
knowledge: The vehicle is running with the 1st gear command on, and the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the 3rd gear ratio is incorrect. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, shift solenoid valve, transmission hydraulic sensor, solenoid valve failure in the valve body, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, transmission control module failure, etc.

des: Intake Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Low (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. If the intake camshaft adjustment valve circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: DC/DC Converter Status Circuit
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the DC high voltage (200-400 volts) of the HV battery into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle. This fault code will appear if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an internal circuit failure in the DC/DC converter and enters safe mode; causing the auxiliary battery voltage to drop below 11 volts.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense R Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the circuit of the 1st cylinder injector, this fault code will appear.

des: Fuel Pump Secondary Circuit/Open
knowledge: The fuel pump circuit is divided into a primary circuit and a secondary circuit. The primary circuit is responsible for controlling the fuel pump. The fuel pump relay uses a low current from the electronic control unit (ECU) to control the solenoid coil, thereby connecting the fuel pump high current. The secondary circuit refers to the fuel pump monitor (FPM) circuit, which is responsible for monitoring the circuit feedback of the fuel pump.

des: Drive Motor A Phase UVW Circuit Low
Hybrid Battery A Voltage High
Drive Motor A Temperature Sensor Circuit
knowledge: The temperature sensor circuit of the drive motor A is faulty. The causes of the fault include the circuit, connector, electronic control unit, drive motor, etc. The drive motor temperature sensor of some vehicles is integrated with the drive motor. Therefore, if it is determined that the problem is with the temperature sensor itself, it may be necessary to replace the entire drive motor.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit is faulty. The causes of the fault include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Ignition Coil J Primary/Secondary Circuit
knowledge: The function of the ignition coil is to convert the 12 volt voltage of the car battery into thousands or even tens of thousands of volts required for spark plug ignition. There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include ignition start/run circuit, ignition coil circuit, ignition coil itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor 1/2 Correlation (Bank 2)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the signal difference of the catalytic converter temperature sensor 1/2 exceeds the set maximum limit.

des: Shift Time Too Short
Drive Motor B Position Sensor Not Learned
Cold Start Engine Coolant Temperature Performance
knowledge: The engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor transmits the temperature of the engine coolant to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal through the principle of thermistor, which serves as a basis for correcting injection and ignition. This fault code indicates that the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor is faulty when the cold engine is started.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Control Module Internal Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performan
knowledge: This fault code indicates that the voltage of the control module's internal temperature sensor signal circuit exceeds the maximum calibrated range. The cause of the fault is the internal temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Rich to Lean (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. The first bank refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is the second bank. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate of the oxygen sensor signal during the rise and fall process. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that an acceptable voltage change rate is not detected during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from rich to lean, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor D Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Manifold Absolute Pressure/Barometric Pressure Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor is to measure the pressure (vacuum) in the intake manifold. The powertrain control module (PCM) then uses the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (which is linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the base injection amount of the injectors to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. The atmospheric pressure sensor (sometimes called the high altitude compensator, HAC) is to transmit the atmospheric pressure to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. Atmospheric pressure varies with weather and altitude. The lower the pressure, the thinner the air. The powertrain control module (PCM) will correct the fuel delivery based on the atmospheric pressure value to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor/barometric pressure sensor signal voltage is lower than the calibrated low value, this fault code will appear. The fault causes include the MAP or atmospheric pressure (BARO) sensor signal circuit is open or shorted to ground, the reference voltage (VREF) circuit is open, the sensor is faulty, or the electronic control module (PCM or ECM) is faulty.

des: Generator Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The starter/generator of a hybrid vehicle is the same motor, usually located in the transmission. Causes of failure include the generator temperature sensor, circuit, connector, control module, etc.

des: PCM/ECM/TCU Internal Temperature A Too High
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and transmission control module are integrated into the powertrain control module on some cars), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the components responsible for exhaust emission control. The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the engine control module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) / engine control module (ECM) / transmission control module (TCU) temperature sensor signal is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The control module has been temporarily shut down to avoid damage caused by overheating.

des: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Rich to Lean (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that an acceptable voltage change rate is not detected during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from rich to lean, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Isolation Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor transmits the transmission fluid temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal based on the principle of thermistor. Its main function is that when the temperature is too high, the transmission control module (TCU) will downshift and slow down. For some new cars, the TCU uses this temperature signal to determine the viscosity of the transmission fluid, thereby adjusting the line pressure and solenoid valve pressure. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor signal voltage is continuously higher than the calibrated maximum value (temperature below -40 degrees Celsius), this fault code will appear. Fault causes include TFT sensor circuit short circuit to positive pole, connector short circuit, TFT sensor calibration imbalance or fault itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit B Intermittent/Erratic
Fuel Temperature Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The fuel temperature sensor is responsible for monitoring the temperature of the fuel going to the fuel pump to avoid vapor lock caused by excessive temperature (120 degrees Celsius), which may cause damage to the fuel pump or injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the fuel temperature sensor signal voltage. If this voltage exceeds the normal calibration value within a set period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Motor Electronics Coolant Pump A Control Circuit High
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The MECS coolant pump is a 12 volt electric pump controlled by the Electronic Control Unit (ECU). This fault code will appear if the control module detects that the MECS coolant pump control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit Slow Response (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. When the voltage change rate is lower than the calibration value, the electronic control unit (ECU) will begin to modify the air-fuel ratio and try to increase the voltage change rate of the oxygen sensor. If the ECU has reached the acceptable fuel trim limit or has exceeded the acceptable fuel trim time, and still does not monitor an acceptable voltage change rate, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include oxygen sensor contamination due to silicon in the fuel, open circuit of oxygen sensor signal circuit, oxygen sensor itself failure, exhaust pipe or exhaust manifold leakage, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Current Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The battery control module monitors the charge and discharge of the battery through the signal from the battery current sensor. If the control module finds that the battery current sensor signal circuit is faulty, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense Q Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Shift Solenoid A Control Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Fuel Pump Secondary Circuit High
knowledge: The fuel pump circuit is divided into a main circuit and a secondary circuit. The main circuit is responsible for controlling the fuel pump. The fuel pump relay uses a low current from the electronic control unit (ECU) to control the electromagnetic coil, thereby connecting the fuel pump high current. The secondary circuit refers to the fuel pump monitor (FPM) circuit, which is responsible for monitoring the circuit feedback of the fuel pump. The causes of P0232 include the failure of the fuel inertia shut-off valve (IFS) to be reset, the circuit from the fuel pump monitor (FPM) to the fuel pump relay, the fuel pump relay circuit, the fuel pump relay, the electronic control unit (ECU), etc.

des: Cold Start Ignition Timing Performance
knowledge: The cold start emission reduction monitor will frequently test the rationality of each component. During the test, the electronic control unit (ECU) will request to retard the ignition timing. The ignition timing monitor will then compare the actual measured ignition timing with the air flow requested by the ECU. If the actual ignition timing is 5 degrees ahead of the set ignition timing for 4 seconds continuously, this fault code will appear.

des: Output Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The task of the output speed sensor (OSS) is to transmit the speed signal of the transmission output shaft to the electronic control unit (ECU). If the ECU detects that the OSS signal is intermittent or irregular, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include interference of the OSS sensor by non-standard accessories, failure of the OSS sensor itself, circuit or connector failure, etc.

des: A/C Clutch Relay Control Circuit High
knowledge: The air conditioner pulley just idles when the air conditioner is turned off. Only when the air conditioner clutch (under the action of the solenoid valve) is engaged, will the compressor be driven to operate. The function of the air conditioner clutch relay is to control the separation and engagement of the clutch. This fault code indicates that when the air conditioner clutch is commanded to open, the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a high voltage on the air conditioner relay control circuit.

des: Engine Mount B Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: Automobile electronically controlled suspension can adjust the suspension hardness, damping, and vehicle height according to driving needs, thereby improving the vehicle's form stability and handling.

des: Shift Solenoid E
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense Y Circuit
