This fault code indicates that the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected an error in the power steering control circuit. The causes of the fault include the power steering pressure switch, its circuit, connector, or the Electronic Control Unit (ECU).

des: Fuel Pump A Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel pump is to suck the fuel from the fuel tank, pressurize it and deliver it to the fuel supply pipe, and cooperate with the fuel pressure regulator to establish a certain fuel pressure. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the voltage of the fuel pump control circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 5 Glow Plug Control Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 5 glow plug circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense C Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
Transfer Case Control System (MIL Request)
knowledge: The transfer case is an accessory on a four-wheel drive vehicle. Its function is to distribute the power of the engine. It can output power only to the rear axle, or to the front/rear axle at the same time. The malfunction indicator light (MIL), also known as the check engine light, is used to light up a yellow or red engine symbol on the dashboard when the control module detects a fault.

des: Glow Plug/Heater Circuit A
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that the glow plug heater circuit is faulty.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B Stuck Closed
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine heat up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). This fault code indicates that the exhaust pressure control valve B is stuck in the closed position.

des: Low Pressure Fuel System Pressure - Too High
knowledge: The function of the low-pressure fuel pump (40-95psi) is to deliver gasoline from the fuel tank to the high-pressure fuel pump. The camshaft-driven high-pressure fuel pump can pressurize gasoline to a maximum of 1900psi. The fuel system needs to maintain a constant pressure. If the oil pressure is too low, the injector will spray too weakly or not at all. If the oil pressure is too high, the fuel line will be damaged or the injector will be damaged. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the pressure of the low-pressure fuel system is higher than the calibrated maximum value within a set period of time. Excessive pressure may be caused by problems such as the fuel pressure regulator, fuel line blockage, fuel pressure sensor, and fuel pump control module.

des: PCM/ECM/TCU Internal Temperature Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and transmission control module on some cars are integrated into the powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the components responsible for exhaust emission control. The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the engine control module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the temperature sensor signal circuit inside the control module exceeds the maximum range of calibration. The cause of the fault is the internal temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: Gear Shift Reverse Actuator Circuit Range/Performance
Hybrid Battery D Voltage
Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense V Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Cold Start A Camshaft Position Timing Over-Advanced (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valve. When the cold engine is started, if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the A (intake/left/front) camshaft timing exceeds the maximum setting value or is always in the advanced state, this fault code will appear.

des: EVAP Purge Flow Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge these gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chamber. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the EVAP purge flow sensor signal voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value.

des: Control Module VSS Output A
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (in some cars, the engine control module and the transmission control module are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components. The function of the vehicle speed sensor (VSS) is to transmit the speed of the car to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for controlling the engine idle speed, automatic transmission shifting, torque converter locking, engine cooling fan opening and closing, and cruise control and other functions.

des: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the throttle pedal position sensor B circuit voltage exceeds the normal range when the throttle is closed or fully open. The causes of the fault include throttle body failure, throttle link stuck, sensor circuit, interface, or itself failure.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense S Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Manifold Absolute Pressure/Barometric Pressure Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor is to measure the pressure (vacuum) in the intake manifold. The powertrain control module (PCM) then uses the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (which is linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the basic injection amount of the injector to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. The atmospheric pressure sensor (sometimes called the high altitude compensator, HAC) is to transmit the atmospheric pressure to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. Atmospheric pressure varies with weather and altitude. The lower the pressure, the thinner the air. The powertrain control module (PCM) will correct the fuel supply based on the atmospheric pressure value to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor/barometric pressure sensor signal voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The fault causes include MAP or barometric pressure (BARO) sensor signal circuit shorted to positive, sensor failure, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure.

des: Shift Solenoid D Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit Low (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage is lower than the minimum value of the self-test (0.2 volts or 121 degrees Celsius), this fault code will appear.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Circuit Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the turbo/supercharger boost control circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value.

des: Gear Shift Control Module B Communication Circuit Low
Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 2)
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The causes of this fault code include problems with the charge air cooler temperature sensor, its circuit, or connector.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense C Circuit Low
Cylinder 12 - Fuel Trim at Min Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the minimum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Sensor - Circuit
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. This fault code indicates that the circuit voltage of the inlet pressure sensor (downstream of the throttle valve) exceeds the calibrated normal value. This fault code may be a problem with the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor for some vehicles.

des: Hybrid Battery System Voltage Too Low for Voltage Step Up Conversion
Generator Position Sensor Circuit A Low
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the generator position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid vehicle generator; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: HO2S Heater Resistance (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the number of oxygen sensors in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code indicates that the current of the heated oxygen sensor heater control circuit is too low or too high.

des: Pressure Control Solenoid B Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. The causes of this fault code include the pressure control solenoid valve itself, the circuit, the connector, etc. At the same time, it should be noted that in some cases, the failure of the transmission control solenoid valve is not due to electronic problems, but due to pipeline blockage or mechanical problems. Many times, many such failures are caused simply because the transmission oil is too dirty.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the drive motor A position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid drive motor; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Fan Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The cause of the fault may include the fan speed sensor, its circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code will appear when the voltage of the heated oxygen sensor signal is continuously higher than 1.5 volts within a set period of time. The causes of the fault include the oxygen sensor signal circuit shorting to the positive pole, the oxygen sensor itself is faulty, and the electronic control module (PCM or ECM) is faulty, etc.

des: Gear Lever Y Position Circuit High
Drive Motor B Current
Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch G Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Motor Torque Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The control module detected that the motor torque sensor signal is outside the normal calibrated range.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit is faulty. The causes of the fault include the catalytic converter temperature sensor, its circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Clutch Actuator Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The clutch actuator is the executor of the clutch action. Its basic function is to separate and engage the clutch. The electromechanical clutch actuator uses the electric motor as the power source and controls the speed and position to achieve precise adjustment of the clutch engagement process.

des: Cylinder 1 Injection Timing
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the actual timing of the injector deviates from the ideal injection timing by more than the maximum limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Phase U Current Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation A Control Circuit
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. For vehicles with an electronic exhaust gas recirculation system (EEGR), the electronic control unit (ECU) will continuously monitor the EEGR coil and circuit. If conditions such as open circuit and short circuit are found, this fault code will appear. At this time, the entire EEGR system will be disabled and other EEGR monitoring will be terminated. The causes of the fault include EEGR actuator, or its circuit, connector failure, EEGR winch motor, electronic control module, etc.

des: HO2S Heater Control Circuit Low (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in which bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the control circuit voltage of the heater is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Starter Relay Circuit
knowledge: The starter relay (solenoid) works by passing a small current through an electromagnetic coil when the ignition switch is turned on, causing a pair of larger contactors to engage, allowing a large current to pass through the motor to start the engine. This fault code indicates a fault in the starter relay circuit. Causes of the fault include the starter, its circuits, connectors, or the electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Drive Motor B Phase W Current High
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Low Purge Flow
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. This fault code indicates that the evaporative emissions system purge flow rate is too low.

des: Cylinder 12 - Injector Leaking
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the 12th cylinder fuel injector is leaking.

des: Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Control Circuit Low (Bank 1)
knowledge: If the length of the intake manifold runner is optimal, the pressure wave generated by the valve closing will help guide the fuel-air mixture into the engine. The problem is that the optimal intake manifold runner lengths for different engine speeds are also different. The function of the manifold tuning valve (MTV) is to guide the intake air into intake manifolds of different lengths according to the engine speed, so as to optimize the engine torque at different speeds. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the intake manifold tuning valve control circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value during self-test, this fault code will appear.

des: Hydraulic Oil Temperature Sensor Circuit High
Gear Shift Control Module A Communication Circuit
Transmission Component Slipping
Drive Motor A Phase UVW Circuit High
Generator Position Sensor Circuit B
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the generator position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid vehicle generator; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Input/Turbine Speed Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The turbine speed sensor (TSS), also called the input shaft speed sensor (ISS), is used to transmit the speed of the input shaft (that is, the torque converter) to the transmission control module (TCU) in the form of frequency. This information is particularly critical for regulating the torque converter lock clutch. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the input shaft speed sensor signal circuit exceeds the normal range of calibration. Fault causes include TSS sensor, its circuit, connector failure, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure.

des: Drive Motor B Inverter Phase U Over Temperature
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Output Speed Sensor Circuit - Direction Error
knowledge: The task of the output speed sensor (OSS) is to transmit the speed signal of the transmission output shaft to the electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch H Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Cylinder 12 Glow Plug Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 12 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Fan 1 Control Circuit High
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the Fan 1 (Low Speed) Control Variable (FCV) circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value. Fault causes include the fan itself or its control circuit, connector, etc.

des: Fuel Cooler Pump Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel cooler is to reduce the fuel temperature and thus increase the viscosity of low-sulfur diesel. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the fuel cooler pump control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value.

des: Excessive Clutch A Slippage
Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor E Circuit
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is out of the normal range, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid E Intermittent
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Isolation Sensor Circuit Low
Mass or Volume Air Flow B Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects that the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Timing Reference High Resolution Signal B Too Few Pulses
knowledge: The optical sensor provides a high-resolution signal to the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) by counting the pulses on the sensor disk located inside the injection pump. This signal is one of the important references for the PCM to control fuel and timing. The causes of this fault code include the optical sensor, its circuit, connector or PCM.

des: Cylinder 8 - Injector Leaking
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the 8th cylinder fuel injector is leaking.

des: Multiple Gears Engaged
Engine Oil Pressure Sensor/Switch Circuit
knowledge: The function of the oil pressure sensor is to transmit the oil pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the pressure is insufficient, the ECU will issue an alarm signal on the instrument panel. This fault code indicates that the oil pressure sensor/switch circuit is faulty.

des: Hybrid Battery Power Off Circuit High
knowledge: The hybrid battery power off (BPO) circuit is faulty. The causes of the fault include the BPO circuit and the control module.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Sensor B Circuit Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The boost sensor, also called the boost pressure sensor (BPS), is used to transmit the boost pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the boost sensor signal voltage is less than 0.25 volts, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. This fault code indicates that the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation sensor B is wrong.

des: Hybrid Generator Performance
knowledge: Fault of generator A in hybrid vehicle

des: Positive Crankcase Ventilation Heater Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the crankcase positive ventilation (PCV) system is to introduce the blowby gas in the crankcase (at the end of the engine's combustion process, some unburned mixture leaks from the piston ring into the crankcase under high pressure, and the industry calls this leakage blowby gas) into the intake manifold through the vacuum generated by the engine, and then the blowby gas will enter the cylinder together with the fresh air and burn, thereby reducing pollution and improving engine efficiency. If the electronic control unit (PCV) detects that the crankcase positive ventilation heater circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: System Too Lean (Bank 1)
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the injector opening time to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (air to gasoline mass ratio of 14.7:1) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if the adaptive fuel control system has reached its compensation limit and the air-fuel ratio is still lean. Causes include air leaks after the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, PCV system leaks, oxygen sensor failure, exhaust leaks near the oxygen sensor, EGR leaks, mass air flow (MAF) sensor failure, dirty fuel filter, insufficient fuel pump supply, fuel pressure regulator failure, injector blockage, engine speed sensor failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor G Circuit Low
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Phase V Current Low
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the generator inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor F Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The battery control module controls the opening/closing of the battery fan based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects an error in the battery temperature sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Control Circuit
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) controls the generator through the generator start signal circuit. When the generator is required to run, the ECU sends a 5V signal to the voltage regulator through the generator start signal circuit. After receiving this signal, the voltage regulator will start to control the generator field circuit. If the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects that the generator start circuit voltage is incorrect, this fault code will appear.

The powertrain control module (PCM) then uses the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (which is linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the basic injection amount of the injector to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. The function of the atmospheric pressure sensor (sometimes called the high altitude compensator, HAC) is to transmit the atmospheric pressure to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. Atmospheric pressure varies with weather and altitude. The lower the pressure, the thinner the air. The powertrain control module (PCM) will correct the fuel supply based on the atmospheric pressure value to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor/barometric pressure sensor, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include MAP or barometric pressure (BARO) sensor signal circuit open or shorted to ground (intermittent), reference voltage (VREF) circuit open, sensor failure, etc.

There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include ignition start/run circuit, ignition coil circuit, ignition coil itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the heated oxygen sensor heater to ensure that there is no open circuit, short circuit, or excessive current consumption. If the current consumption exceeds the calibrated limit, or an open circuit or short circuit is detected, the fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the oxygen sensor heater circuit, connector failure, oxygen sensor itself failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: System Too Lean (Bank 2)
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the injector opening time to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (air to gasoline mass ratio of 14.7:1) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if the adaptive fuel control system has reached its compensation limit and the air-fuel ratio is still lean. Causes include air leaks after the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, PCV system leaks, oxygen sensor failure, exhaust leaks near the oxygen sensor, EGR leaks, mass air flow (MAF) sensor failure, dirty fuel filter, insufficient fuel pump supply, fuel pressure regulator failure, injector blockage, engine speed sensor failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Charge Air Cooler Bypass Control A Circuit High
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the air cooler bypass valve control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit Intermittent (Bank 1)

If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid F Control Circuit Low

The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Clutch Position Not Learned

des: Cylinder 4 - Injector Restricted
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the performance of the 4th cylinder fuel injector is wrong.

des: Cylinder 3 Injection Timing

The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the actual timing of the injector deviates from the ideal injection timing by more than the maximum limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit Stuck On
knowledge: The torque converter acts like a clutch in a manual transmission, allowing the torque from the engine to be temporarily disconnected from the transmission, allowing for smooth gear changes. A control module fault may also cause this fault code to appear.

des: Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Control Circuit/Open (Bank 1)

The problem is that the optimal intake manifold runner lengths are different for different engine speeds. The function of the intake manifold tuning valve (IMTV) is to direct the intake air into intake manifolds of different lengths according to the engine speed, so as to optimize the engine torque at different speeds. This fault code will appear if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the intake manifold tuning valve control circuit voltage exceeds the calibrated positive constant value during self-test. Fault causes include IMTV signal circuit open or short circuit to ground, IMTV actuator assembly failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: HO2S Heater Resistance (Bank 2, Sensor 2)

Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). If the current of the heated oxygen sensor heater control circuit is too low or too high, this fault code will appear.

More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. des: Ignition Coil K Primary/Secondary Circuit
knowledge: The function of the ignition coil is to convert the 12 volt voltage of the car battery into thousands or even tens of thousands of volts required for spark plug ignition. There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense E Circuit Intermittent/Erratic

des: Transmission Range Sensor A Circuit (PRNDL Input)

The ECU controls the amount of fuel entering the fuel injection pump by cycling the FCA open and closed.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B

Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). The electronic control unit (ECU) detected that the voltage of the exhaust pressure control valve A circuit exceeded the calibrated normal value. The cause of the fault includes the exhaust flap valve or its circuit.

des: Cylinder 8 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector circuit of the 8th cylinder, this fault code will appear.

des: TCU Engine Speed Output Circuit

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation B Control Stuck Closed

The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the actual exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve position is lower than 15% when the command actual exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve position is higher than 30% within a set time period (4 seconds), the electronic control unit will think that the EGR is stuck in the closed position.

des: Cylinder 10 Contribution/Balance

The causes of the fault include an open circuit or short circuit to ground in the secondary air injection actuator circuit, an actuator failure, or a failure of the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Cylinder 10 Misfire Detected
knowledge: Cylinder misfire refers to the phenomenon that the mixture cannot burn normally in the cylinder due to various reasons during the operation of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected a misfire in cylinder 10. The causes of the fault include ignition system failure, fuel delivery failure, air leakage in the intake manifold or EGR, PCV, mechanical cylinder failure, etc.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Circuit/Open

A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the turbo/supercharger boost control A circuit is out of the normal range of calibration.

des: Gear 4 Incorrect Ratio

If the oil pressure is too low, the injector will spray too weakly or not at all. If the oil pressure is too high, the fuel line will be damaged or the injector will be damaged. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the pressure of the low-pressure fuel system is lower than the calibrated minimum value within a set period of time. Low pressure may be caused by problems such as the fuel pump, fuel pressure regulator, fuel pressure sensor, fuel pump control module, and fuel leakage.

des: Knock Sensor 3 Circuit High (Bank 1)

des: TCU Communication Circuit Range/Performance

des: Cruise Control Vacuum Control Circuit High
knowledge: The cruise control system controls the throttle angle and thus the vehicle speed by controlling the vacuum in the servo. When acceleration is required, the vacuum solenoid valve opens and communicates with the intake manifold (or a special vacuum pump). The vacuum in the sealing sleeve increases, sucking the diaphragm, overcoming the spring force, and increasing the throttle opening by pulling the wire, so that the vehicle accelerates. When the set speed is reached, the vacuum solenoid valve and the ventilation solenoid valve are closed at the same time. At this time, the vacuum in the sealing sleeve remains unchanged, and the car maintains a constant speed. When deceleration is required, the ventilation solenoid valve opens to allow air to enter the sealing sleeve, and the diaphragm spring presses the diaphragm back to its original position, the throttle opening decreases, and the car decelerates. P0584 indicates that the vacuum control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The causes of the fault include the cruise control vacuum control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 8 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit Slow Response (Bank 1, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. When the voltage change rate is lower than the calibration value, the electronic control unit (ECU) will begin to modify the air-fuel ratio and try to increase the voltage change rate of the oxygen sensor. If the ECU has reached the acceptable fuel trim limit or has exceeded the acceptable fuel trim time, and still does not monitor an acceptable voltage change rate, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include oxygen sensor contamination due to silicon in the fuel, open circuit of oxygen sensor signal circuit, oxygen sensor itself failure, exhaust pipe or exhaust manifold leakage, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Ignition Coil B Primary/Secondary Circuit
knowledge: The function of the ignition coil is to convert the 12 volt voltage of the car battery into thousands or even tens of thousands of volts required for spark plug ignition. There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include ignition start/run circuit, ignition coil circuit, ignition coil itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense D Circuit
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Mass or Volume Air Flow B Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects that the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Fuel Pump Secondary Circuit Low
knowledge: The fuel pump circuit is divided into a main circuit and a secondary circuit. The main circuit is responsible for controlling the fuel pump. The fuel pump relay uses a low current from the electronic control unit (ECU) to control the electromagnetic coil, thereby connecting the fuel pump high current. The secondary circuit refers to the fuel pump monitor (FPM) circuit, which is responsible for monitoring the circuit feedback of the fuel pump. The causes of P0231 include the circuit from the fuel pump monitor (FPM) to the fuel pump relay, the fuel pump relay circuit, the fuel pump relay, the electronic control unit (ECU), etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor H Circuit High
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid G Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch E Circuit
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Sensor A Circuit Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The boost sensor, also called the boost pressure sensor (BPS), is used to transmit the boost pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the boost sensor signal voltage is less than 0.25 volts, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid A Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 5 Injector Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the 5th cylinder injector control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Shift Solenoid B Electrical
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Upshift Switch Circuit
Reverse Incorrect Ratio
knowledge: The vehicle is running with the reverse gear command turned on, and the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the reverse gear ratio is incorrect. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, shift solenoid valve, transmission hydraulic sensor, solenoid valve failure in the valve body, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, transmission control module failure, etc.

des: Cruise Control Multi-Function Input B Circuit High
knowledge: The cruise control system allows the driver to automatically maintain the vehicle speed without stepping on the accelerator pedal. Faults may include the cruise control multi-function input switch, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit A Range/Performance
O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Lean to Rich (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the voltage change rate lags behind during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from lean to rich, this fault code will appear.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1, Sensor 2)

In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code will appear when the voltage of the heated oxygen sensor signal is continuously higher than 1.5 volts within a set period of time. The causes of the fault include short circuit of the oxygen sensor circuit to the positive pole, fault of the oxygen sensor itself, and fault of the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Hybrid Battery Pack State of Charge High

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Phase UVW Circuit Low

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Current Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The battery control module monitors the charge and discharge of the battery through the signal from the battery current sensor. If the control module finds that the battery current sensor is faulty, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Temperature Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The temperature sensor circuit of the drive motor A is faulty. The causes of the fault include the circuit, connector, electronic control unit, drive motor, etc. The drive motor temperature sensor of some vehicles is integrated with the drive motor. Therefore, if it is determined that the problem is with the temperature sensor itself, it may be necessary to replace the entire drive motor.

des: Generator Position Sensor Circuit Overspeed
knowledge: The generator has exceeded its calibrated maximum engine speed limit.

des: Hybrid Battery Positive Contactor Circuit Stuck Open
knowledge: The System Main Relay (SMR) is responsible for turning the high voltage power supply on and off. If one of the 1st and 2nd System Main Relays (SMR) is stuck, it may cause the high voltage system to not shut down. Therefore, if the hybrid vehicle electronic control unit detects a fault in any of these relays, it will terminate the entire system.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Circuit Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the turbo/supercharger boost control circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Module Performance
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the turbo/supercharger boost control module B is faulty.

des: Vehicle Speed Sensor A Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the vehicle speed sensor (VSS) is to transmit the speed of the car to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for controlling engine idle speed, automatic transmission shifting, torque converter lock, engine cooling fan opening and closing, and other functions such as cruise control. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the actual vehicle speed is too different from the estimated vehicle speed based on other inputs, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include VSS sensor circuit or connector failure, VSS sensor failure, VSS mechanical connection failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Auto Shift Manual Mode Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: Automatic shift manual transmissions allow the driver to put the transmission into manual mode and manually control upshifts or downshifts.

des: Fuel System Leak Detected - Small Leak
Cylinder 5 Misfire Detected
knowledge: Cylinder misfire refers to the phenomenon that the mixture cannot burn normally in the cylinder due to various reasons during the operation of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected a misfire in cylinder 5. The causes of the fault include ignition system failure, fuel delivery failure, air leakage in the intake manifold or EGR, PCV, mechanical cylinder failure, etc.

des: Clutch Actuator Circuit/Open
knowledge: The clutch actuator is the executor of the clutch action. Its basic function is to separate and engage the clutch. The electromechanical clutch actuator uses the electric motor as the power source and controls the speed and position to achieve precise adjustment of the clutch engagement process.

des: Transmission Friction Element H Stuck On
Generator Phase U Current Low
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the generator inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense L Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Knock Sensor 4 Circuit Low (Bank 2)
knowledge: The knock sensor is responsible for detecting vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to prevent knocking. If this voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense C Circuit
Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense P Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Fuel Volume Regulator Control Circuit Low
knowledge: (In new cars where fuel injectors are widely used, fuel regulators are rarely used)

des: Internal Control Module EEPROM Error
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components.

des: Fuel Rail/System Pressure - Too High
knowledge: The fuel system needs to maintain a constant pressure. If the oil pressure is too low, the injector will spray too weakly or not at all. If the oil pressure is too high, the oil circuit will be damaged or the injector will be damaged. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the fuel supply pipe pressure is higher than the calibrated maximum value within a set period of time. Excessive pressure may be caused by problems such as the fuel pressure regulator, oil circuit blockage, fuel pressure sensor, and fuel pump control module.

des: Cylinder 2 Injector Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the second cylinder injector control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Motor Torque Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The control module detected that the motor torque sensor signal is outside the normal calibrated range.

des: Cruise Control Vent Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The cruise control system controls the throttle angle and thus the vehicle speed by controlling the vacuum in the servo. When acceleration is required, the vacuum solenoid valve opens and communicates with the intake manifold (or a special vacuum pump). The vacuum in the sealing sleeve increases, sucking the diaphragm, overcoming the spring force, and increasing the throttle opening by pulling the wire, so that the vehicle accelerates. When the set speed is reached, the vacuum solenoid valve and the ventilation solenoid valve are closed at the same time. At this time, the vacuum in the sealing sleeve remains unchanged, and the car maintains a constant speed. When deceleration is required, the ventilation solenoid valve opens to allow air to enter the sealing sleeve, and the diaphragm spring presses the diaphragm back to its original position, the throttle opening decreases, and the car decelerates. P0586 indicates that the voltage of the ventilation control circuit of the cruise control system is lower than the calibrated minimum value. The causes of the fault include the cruise control system vent solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Cylinder 2 Glow Plug Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 2 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Sensor Reference Voltage A Circuit/Open
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected an error in the 5V reference voltage circuit A. Causes of the fault include a short circuit or short circuit from the 5V reference voltage circuit to a sensor, a short circuit or open circuit in one or more sensors, an automatic transmission hydraulic sensor fault, a solenoid valve fault, a transmission control module fault, a transmission input speed (RPM) sensor fault, a transmission output speed (RPM) sensor fault, etc.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 2 Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. After the engine is shut down for a certain period of time (usually 6 hours), the electronic control unit (ECU) will determine the rationality of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor by comparing the readings of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor with the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor. If the difference between the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor reading and the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor reading exceeds the set calibration value (usually 17°C) when the engine is started next time, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense B Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Engine Position System Performance (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. The engine position system uses the signals of the crankshaft position sensor and the camshaft position sensor to generate an angle counter. The angle counter is then synchronized with the crankshaft wheel angle to provide the current position of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the two camshafts of the first bank do not match the crankshaft within a certain period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Phase W Current Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Phase V Current Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Timing Reference High Resolution Signal A Too Few Pulses
knowledge: The optical sensor provides a high-resolution signal to the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) by counting the pulses on the sensor disk located inside the injection pump. This signal is one of the important references for the PCM to control fuel and timing. The causes of this fault code include the optical sensor, its circuit, connector or PCM.

des: Vehicle Speed Sensor A Intermittent/Erratic/High
knowledge: The function of the vehicle speed sensor (VSS) is to transmit the speed of the car to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for controlling engine idle speed, automatic transmission shifting, torque converter lock, engine cooling fan opening and closing, and cruise control and other functions. The vehicle speed reading can come from the vehicle speed sensor (VSS), transfer case speed sensor, or anti-lock brake (ABS) control module. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the vehicle speed is unstable, this fault code will appear.

des: HO2S Heater Control Circuit (Bank 2, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the oxygen sensor does not reach the required temperature within the set time, or the ECU cannot maintain the set temperature, this fault code will appear.

The causes of the fault include injector interface, circuit failure, injector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: EVAP Purge Flow Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge these gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the EVAP purge flow sensor signal voltage.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Control Module Circuit/Open

The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor B Circuit High

des: Fan Overspeed
Transmission Mode Switch A Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the transmission mode switch is to instruct the transmission to shift earlier or later, or start in high gear, etc. according to the mode selected by the user (sports/economy/winter, etc.). Fault causes include the transmission mode switch, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: Shift Solenoid H Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. des: Drive Motor B Position Sensor Circuit High

des: DC/DC Converter Temperature Sensor B Range/Performance
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the HV battery's high DC voltage (200-400 volts) into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle.

des: Idle Air Control System RPM Lower Than Expected
knowledge: The Idle Air Control (IAC) valve has a movable needle valve controlled by a precision moving stepper motor. When the throttle is closed, the IAC valve controls the idle speed by changing the air flow in the bypass line to adapt to the idle speed under different conditions. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the engine speed is lower than the set value, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include air inlet obstruction, IAC circuit failure, IAC solenoid valve failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, vehicle speed sensor failure, etc.

des: Glow Plug Control Module Control Circuit Low

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense B Circuit Low
Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 1, Sensor 1)

The causes of the fault include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Transmission Range Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance

The cause of this fault code is often a problem with the transmission gear position sensor connector, circuit, or itself, and it may also be a problem with the ECU.

des: Transmission Fluid Deteriorated

des: Cylinder 5 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Max Limit

This fault code indicates that the voltage of the shift solenoid valve control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value.

des: Injector Circuit/Open - Cylinder 11
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector control circuit, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include injector interface, circuit failure, injector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate Solenoid B Low
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the wastegate solenoid valve is to adjust the turbine speed and thus the maximum boost pressure by controlling the exhaust gas flow entering the turbine (bypassing the rest of the exhaust gas). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the wastegate solenoid valve B circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Cruise Control Multi-Function Input B Circuit Stuck
