knowledge: The cruise control system allows the driver to automatically maintain the vehicle speed without stepping on the accelerator pedal. Faults may include the cruise control multi-function input switch, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Fuel Pressure Regulator 1 Control Circuit High
knowledge: The fuel pressure regulator uses a spring-loaded valve to return excess gasoline to the fuel tank, thereby maintaining a constant pressure in the fuel line. There is a vacuum tube on the fuel pressure regulator that is connected to the intake manifold to provide the appropriate gasoline pressure under different engine operating conditions (according to the vacuum level to determine the engine load). Most cars have fuel pressure regulators located on the fuel rail, but some cars have fuel pressure regulators located inside the fuel tank. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the fuel pressure regulator 1 control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B Range/Performance
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine heat up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). The electronic control unit (ECU) detected that the exhaust pressure control valve A circuit voltage error. The cause of the fault includes the exhaust flap valve or its circuit.

des: Generator Position Sensor Circuit A Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the generator position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid vehicle generator; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Torque Management System - Forced Engine Shutdown
knowledge: The function of the torque management system is to reduce the engine torque by temporarily shutting down the injector or delaying the ignition during the transmission shifting or wheel slipping process, so as to make the gear shifting smoother and reduce the wear on the transmission system.

des: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the injector control circuit of the first cylinder is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Control Circuit High
knowledge: The fan motor controller is responsible for regulating the voltage of the hybrid battery pack cooling fan. If the cooling fan 1 control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 11 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the circuit of the 11th cylinder injector, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid E Stuck On
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Stuck in Gear 2
knowledge: While the vehicle is driving, the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the shift solenoid valve is faulty (stuck), causing the transmission to be stuck in 2nd gear. The causes of the fault include the shift solenoid valve, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, control module, and transmission mechanical failure, etc.

des: Transmission Mode Switch B Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the transmission mode switch is to instruct the transmission to shift earlier or later, or start in high gear, etc. according to the mode selected by the user (sports/economy/winter, etc.). Fault causes include the transmission mode switch, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Current Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The battery control module monitors the charge and discharge of the battery through the signal from the battery current sensor. If the control module finds that the battery current sensor signal circuit is faulty, this fault code will appear.

des: Fuel Level Output Circuit
knowledge: The fuel level sensor uses a float and a variable resistor in the fuel tank to transmit the fuel level in the tank to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal.

des: Intake Air Temperature/Ambient Air Temperature Correlation
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to convert the engine's intake air temperature into a voltage signal and input it to the electronic control unit (ECU), providing a reference for injection correction. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the difference between the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor and the ambient air temperature sensor is greater than the maximum allowable limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Engine Coolant Over Temperature Condition
knowledge: The engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor or cylinder head temperature (CHT) sensor signal indicates that the engine is in an overtemperature state. Faults may include low coolant level, thermostat stuck closed, fan, coolant pump, or radiator.

des: Drive Motor B Inverter Voltage Too High
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: HO2S Heater Control Circuit (Bank 1, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the oxygen sensor does not reach the required temperature within the set time, or the ECU cannot maintain the set temperature, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense D Circuit
Fan Circuit Over Current
Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit High (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage is higher than the maximum value of the self-test (4.6 volts or -50 degrees Celsius), this fault code will appear.

des: Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic (Bank 2)
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The causes of this fault code include problems with the charge air cooler temperature sensor, its circuit, or connector.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense D Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Shift Solenoid A Stuck On
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Replace Hybrid Battery Pack
knowledge: The battery control module is responsible for monitoring the voltage of the battery pack. If the voltage difference between the battery packs exceeds the standard value, this fault code will appear.

des: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is usually located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. The electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exchange rate of the oxygen sensor 1/2 is equivalent to the exchange rate of 1/1, so it is inferred that the catalytic converter system efficiency is too low. The causes of the fault include exhaust gas leakage near the exhaust pipe or exhaust manifold, catalyst box failure, engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor failure, engine misfire or timing lag, dirty engine oil, oxygen sensor failure, and too high fuel system pressure.

des: Cylinder 8 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Min Limit
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the compensation learning of the 8th cylinder injector has reached the minimum learning limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
Exhaust Gas Recirculation Temperature Sensor A/B Correlation
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal difference between the exhaust gas recirculation valve (EGR) temperature sensor A and B exceeds the set maximum limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cruise Control Vacuum Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The cruise control system controls the throttle angle and thus the vehicle speed by controlling the vacuum in the servo. When acceleration is required, the vacuum solenoid valve opens and communicates with the intake manifold (or a special vacuum pump). The vacuum in the sealing sleeve increases, sucking the diaphragm, overcoming the spring force, and increasing the throttle opening by pulling the wire, so that the vehicle accelerates. When the set speed is reached, the vacuum solenoid valve and the ventilation solenoid valve are closed at the same time. At this time, the vacuum in the sealing sleeve remains unchanged, and the car maintains a constant speed. When deceleration is required, the ventilation solenoid valve opens to allow air to enter the sealing sleeve, and the diaphragm spring presses the diaphragm back to its original position, the throttle opening decreases, and the car decelerates. P0582 indicates that the vacuum control circuit is wrong. The causes of the fault include the cruise control vacuum control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit Slow Response (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. When the voltage change rate is lower than the calibration value, the electronic control unit (ECU) will begin to modify the air-fuel ratio and try to increase the voltage change rate of the oxygen sensor. If the ECU has reached the acceptable fuel trim limit or has exceeded the acceptable fuel trim time, and still does not monitor an acceptable voltage change rate, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include oxygen sensor contamination due to silicon in the fuel, open circuit of oxygen sensor signal circuit, oxygen sensor itself failure, exhaust pipe or exhaust manifold leakage, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Cold Start Injector 1
knowledge: When the car is started, if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the engine temperature is lower than a certain set value, the cold start injector (CSI) will enrich the air-fuel ratio by injecting gasoline into the intake system when the starter rotates, making the engine easier to start. P0213 indicates that the cold start injector 1 is faulty.

des: Drive Motor B Phase W Current Sensor Circuit
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: TCU Power Input Signal High
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, allowing the vehicle to improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel.

des: Transmission Control System Electrical
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. Fault causes include the Transmission Control Module (TCM), Engine Control Module (ECM), circuits, etc.

des: Starter Disable Circuit High
Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense U Circuit
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Fuel Pressure Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The fuel pressure regulator uses a spring-loaded valve to return excess fuel to the tank, thereby maintaining constant pressure in the fuel line. The fuel pressure regulator has a vacuum line connected to the intake manifold to provide appropriate fuel pressure under different engine operating conditions (engine load is determined by the vacuum level). Most cars have the fuel pressure regulator located on the fuel rail, but some cars have the fuel pressure regulator located inside the fuel tank. The fuel pressure sensor is responsible for measuring the fuel pressure near the injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) uses this signal to adjust the injector pulse width and measure the amount of fuel entering the combustion chamber. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the fuel pressure sensor signal voltage. If this value fails intermittently, the test fails.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Isolation Sensor Circuit
Cylinder 4 Contribution/Balance
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the crankshaft acceleration contribution of the 4th cylinder is lower than the calibrated value. Fault causes include the 4th cylinder injection system; or other engine problems affecting the 4th cylinder.

des: Cylinder 8 - Fuel Trim at Max Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the maximum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Generator Torque Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The control module has detected that the generator torque sensor signal is outside the normal calibrated range.

des: Gear Shift Reverse Actuator Circuit/Open
Cylinder 4 Glow Plug Control Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 4 glow plug circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: HO2S Heater Control Circuit High (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in which bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the control circuit voltage of the heater is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hydraulic Oil Temperature Sensor Circuit
Power Steering Pressure Sensor/Switch Circuit Low
knowledge: The power steering pressure (PSP) sensor transmits the power steering load pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal based on the principle of a potentiometer. If the load pressure is too large, the ECU will increase the engine idle speed and shut down the air conditioning compressor if necessary to prevent the engine from stalling. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the power steering pressure sensor signal voltage is lower than the minimum value of the self-test, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include PSP sensor circuit open circuit or short circuit to ground, PSP sensor failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 7 Glow Plug Incorrect
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that there is an error in the cylinder 7 glow plug, its circuit, connector, or the glow plug control module (GPCM).

des: Transmission Park Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the parking position sensor is to send a signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) indicating whether the shift lever is in the parking position. If the ECU detects that the parking position sensor circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the air conditioning refrigerant pressure sensor is to transmit the air conditioning refrigerant pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal as a basis for controlling the cooling fan switch and the compressor relay. If the electronic control unit detects that the air conditioning pressure sensor signal circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Idle Air Control System
knowledge: The Idle Air Control (IAC) valve has a movable needle valve controlled by a precision moving stepper motor. With the throttle closed, the IAC valve controls the idle speed by varying the air flow in the bypass line to suit the idle speed under different conditions. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) attempts to control the engine speed during the engine self-test with the key on. If the ECU finds that it cannot control the engine to the desired speed, this fault code will appear.

des: Ambient Air Temperature Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the ambient air temperature sensor is to transmit the external air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio. This fault code indicates that the ambient air temperature sensor signal voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value.

des: Gear Lever X Position Circuit Range/Performance
TCU Power Relay Sense Circuit
knowledge: The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the engine control module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. The function of the control module relay is to continue to keep the control module powered after the ignition switch is turned off until the control module completes the shutdown process.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Control Module Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate Solenoid A Range/Performance
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the wastegate solenoid valve is to adjust the turbine speed and thus the maximum boost pressure by controlling the exhaust gas flow entering the turbine (bypassing the rest of the exhaust gas). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the wastegate solenoid valve A, this fault code will appear.

des: Four Wheel Drive (4WD) Switch Circuit High
Mass or Volume Air Flow B Circuit
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects that the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor exceeds the normal calibrated range, this fault code will appear.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Current High
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Internal Control Module Drive Motor/Generator - Engine Speed Sensor Performance
Clutch Position Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The clutch position sensor transmits information about whether the clutch is depressed in the form of an electrical signal to the electronic control unit, which serves as an important parameter for controlling engine start and cruise control systems.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense G Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected (small leak)
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) continuously monitors the EVAP control system to ensure that there are no fuel vapor leaks. If the ECU detects a small (larger than 1.016 mm in diameter) fuel vapor leak, this fault code will appear.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity Detected (Bank 2, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the heated oxygen sensor to determine that the oxygen sensor is working. If the heated oxygen sensor signal value continues to stay at the default value, the electronic control unit (ECU) will command an oscillating air/fuel ratio to try to detect some changes in the signal value. If the ECU still cannot detect changes in the sensor's signal at this time, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include leaks in the exhaust manifold or exhaust pipe, faults in the oxygen sensor itself or its circuit or connector, and faults in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Module Performance
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the turbo/supercharger boost control module A is faulty.

des: Main Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the efficiency of the main catalytic converter is lower than the set minimum limit. The causes of the fault include the catalytic converter, oxygen sensor, circuit, connector, etc. The causes of the fault include exhaust gas leakage near the exhaust pipe or exhaust manifold, catalyst box failure, engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor failure, engine misfire or timing lag, dirty engine oil, oxygen sensor failure, and too high fuel system pressure.

des: Drive Motor A Phase W Current
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Current Low
Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve B Circuit Open
knowledge: When the engine is just started, the secondary air injection system oxidizes harmful gases such as hydrocarbons and carbon monoxide by forcing air into the exhaust manifold. This process also accelerates the warming process of the catalytic converter. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an open circuit in the secondary air injection system control solenoid valve circuit, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include an open circuit or short circuit to ground in the secondary air injection actuator circuit, a switching valve failure, a secondary air injection pump failure, a relay failure, or an electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure.

des: Drive Motor A Inverter Performance
knowledge: The inverter converts direct current into alternating current. The hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter voltage sensor circuit. If the HV ECU detects an inverter voltage sensor error, this fault code will appear.

des: Intake Air Heater A Circuit Low
knowledge: The intake air heater, also called the manifold intake air heater, is used to preheat the intake air to help the diesel engine start easily in cold weather. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the manifold intake air heater circuit (MIAH) circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Knock Sensor 4 Circuit High (Bank 2)
knowledge: The knock sensor is responsible for detecting vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to prevent knocking. If this voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Error
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCU) has detected a common shift valve fault.

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor C Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Injection Pump Fuel Metering Control A Range/Performance (Cam/Rotor/Injector)
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the fuel control actuator (FCA), its circuit, the fuel injection pump, or the electronic control module (ECU). The fuel control actuator (FCA) is usually located on the back side of the fuel injection pump. It is an electronically controlled solenoid valve. The ECU controls the amount of fuel entering the fuel injection pump by cycling the FCA open and closed.

des: Internal Control Module Fuel Injector Control Performance
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation A Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the actual exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve position differs from the commanded EGR valve position by more than 10%, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Performance
knowledge: Fault of hybrid vehicle drive motor B

des: Timing Reference High Resolution Signal A No Pulses
knowledge: The optical sensor provides a high-resolution signal to the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) by counting the pulses on the sensor disk located inside the injection pump. This signal is one of the important references for the PCM to control fuel and timing. The causes of this fault code include the optical sensor, its circuit, connector or PCM.

des: Fuel Trim (Bank 2)
knowledge: Fuel trimming is when the electronic control unit (ECU) controls fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the amount of time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, while too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. P0170 is often caused by a malfunction in the fuel injection system. Causes include air leaks after the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, PCV system leaks, exhaust leaks near or before the oxygen sensor, a clogged injector or other fuel system malfunction, an EGR system leak, a contaminated MAF sensor (causing the ECU to underestimate the air flow), a low fuel tank level, or an oil dipstick that is not properly seated.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor G Range/Performance
knowledge: The battery control module controls the opening/closing of the battery fan based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects an error in the battery temperature sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) sensor exceeds the normal range of calibration, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Low
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Positive Crankcase Ventilation Regulator Valve Performance
knowledge: The function of the crankcase positive ventilation (PCV) system is to guide the blowby gas in the crankcase (at the end of the engine's combustion process, some unburned mixture leaks from the piston ring into the crankcase under high pressure, and the industry calls this leakage blowby gas) into the intake manifold through the vacuum generated by the engine. Then the blowby gas will enter the cylinder together with the fresh air and burn, thereby reducing pollution and improving engine efficiency.

des: Cold Start Injector 2
knowledge: When the car is started, if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the engine temperature is lower than a certain set value, the cold start injector (CSI) will enrich the air-fuel ratio by injecting gasoline into the intake system when the starter rotates, making the engine easier to start. P0214 indicates that the cold start injector 2 is faulty.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Flow Valve A Control Circuit High
Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor/Switch Low
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. This fault code appears if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the input signal from the EVAP fuel tank pressure sensor to the ECU is below the minimum calibrated value (0.22 volts).

des: Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Circuit (Bank 2)
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The causes of this fault code include problems with the charge air cooler temperature sensor, its circuit, or connector.

des: O2 Sensor Signals Swapped (Bank 1, Sensor 1)/(Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor monitors whether the oxygen sensor signal response caused by the fuel change corresponds to the correct oxygen sensor row (Bank). Possible causes of this fault code include mixing up the oxygen sensor plugs and wiring, etc.

des: Gear 1 Incorrect Ratio
knowledge: The vehicle is running with the 1st gear command on, and the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the 1st gear ratio is incorrect. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, shift solenoid valve, transmission hydraulic sensor, solenoid valve failure in the valve body, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, transmission control module failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 9 Glow Plug Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 9 glow plug control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery System Precharge Time Too Short
Gate Select Position Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: Door select position (monitors shift lever left/right position) circuit fault.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor D/E Correlation
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the signal difference of the battery temperature sensor D/E exceeds the maximum limit of calibration, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation B Control Circuit
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve control circuit voltage is out of the normal range of calibration, this fault code will appear.

des: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the fuel cut-off valve is to cut off the fuel supply to the engine when the car encounters an emergency (such as rollover). This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected that the voltage of the fuel cut-off valve A control circuit exceeds the maximum range of calibration.

des: Gear Shift Forward Actuator Circuit High
Odometer Not Programmed - ECM/PCM
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components.

des: Pressure Control Solenoid C Stuck On
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or control module, etc.

des: Intake Air Heater A Circuit Open
knowledge: The intake air heater, also called the manifold intake air heater, is used to preheat the intake air to help the diesel engine start easily in cold weather. This fault code indicates that the manifold intake air heater circuit (MIAH) circuit has a fault.

des: Drive Motor A Phase W Current High
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 4 Glow Plug Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 4 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch B Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Drive Motor B Torque Delivered Performance
Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor B Circuit Low
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Clutch Pedal Switch A Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the clutch pedal switch is to transmit the information of whether the clutch is pressed to the electronic control unit in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as an important parameter for controlling the engine start and cruise control system.

des: Shift Solenoid E Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Starter Request Circuit
Generator Phase U Current
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the generator inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Upshift/Skip Shift Solenoid Control Circuit Low
knowledge: For some high-powered cars, in order to improve the fuel efficiency and reduce emissions, when the conditions are met (low speed, low throttle, car preheated, etc.), the shift solenoid valve will prevent the 2nd and 3rd gears from being engaged, which is equivalent to forcing the gear lever to shift directly from 1st gear to 4th gear. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the shift solenoid valve control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value.

des: Hybrid Battery System Voltage Low
knowledge: This fault code will appear if the overall voltage of the hybrid battery pack is lower than the set value, or the voltage of each battery block is lower than the set value.

des: Injector Circuit/Open - Cylinder 4
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector control circuit, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include injector interface, circuit failure, injector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense B Circuit
Cylinder 9 Glow Plug Incorrect
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that there is an error in the cylinder 9 glow plug, its circuit, connector, or the glow plug control module (GPCM).

des: Cylinder 5 Injector Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the injector opening time interval (also called pulse width). If the voltage of the 5th cylinder injector control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Drive Motor A Phase V Current
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Purge Control Valve Circuit Low
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapor from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapor. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapor into the engine combustion chamber. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects that the evaporative emissions system purge control valve control circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value. Fault causes include EVAP power supply circuit failure, EVAP solenoid valve control circuit failure, EVAP solenoid valve failure, EVAP charcoal canister leakage, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Generator Torque Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The control module has detected that the generator torque sensor signal is outside the normal calibrated range.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Flow Valve A Control Circuit Range/Performance
Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense K Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense R Circuit
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Reverse Inhibit Control Circuit
knowledge: The function of reverse gear inhibition is to prohibit the shift lever from moving to the R (Reverse) gear position when the vehicle speed is higher than 10km/h. This fault code indicates that the reverse gear inhibition circuit is faulty.

des: MAP - Exhaust Pressure Correlation
knowledge: The function of the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor is to measure the pressure (vacuum) in the intake manifold. The powertrain control module (PCM) then uses the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (which is linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the basic injection amount of the injector to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. The function of the exhaust pressure sensor is to transmit the exhaust system pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the electronic control unit finds that the signal difference between the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor and the exhaust pressure sensor exceeds the calibration value (usually 10.35KPa) within a set time period (2.5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Transmission Range Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The transmission gear position sensor is responsible for transmitting the position of the transmission lever (PRNDL) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the ECU detects that the voltage of the transmission gear position (TR) sensor circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value for more than a set period of time, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include the transmission gear position (TR) sensor, its circuit shorted to the positive terminal, connector failure, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor C Circuit
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) sensor signal voltage is out of the calibrated normal range, this fault code will appear.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch D Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: B Camshaft Position - Actuator Circuit/Open (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valve. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft regulating valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. The causes of P0013 include B exhaust/right/rear camshaft regulating valve (oil control valve), its circuit, connector, dirty oil or ECU.

des: Transmission Park Position Sensor/Switch A/B Correlation
knowledge: The function of the parking position sensor is to transmit the signal of whether the gear lever is in the parking position to the electronic control unit (ECU). If the ECU detects that the signals of the parking position sensors A and B are inconsistent, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Coolant Pump Control Performance
Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Phase V Current
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor is to transmit the temperature inside the air conditioner evaporator to the air conditioner control module in the form of an electrical signal, so that when the temperature inside the air conditioner evaporator is too low, the air conditioner compressor is turned off to prevent the air conditioner evaporator from freezing. This fault code indicates that the air conditioner evaporator temperature (ACET) sensor signal circuit voltage is out of the calibration range.

des: Transmission Friction Element F Slip Detected
Heated Catalyst Temperature Below Threshold (Bank 2)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the temperature of the catalytic converter is lower than the set minimum limit after preheating. The causes of the fault include the catalytic converter, oxygen sensor, circuit, connector, etc.

des: A Camshaft Profile Control Circuit/Open (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. This optimizes the efficiency and power of the engine in all speed ranges. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the A (intake/left/front) camshaft profile control circuit exceeds the calibrated normal range for a period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit High (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. If the exhaust camshaft adjustment valve circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Temperature Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation valve (EGR) temperature sensor is incorrect, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 11 Contribution/Balance
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the crankshaft acceleration contribution of cylinder 11 is lower than the calibrated value. Fault causes include the injection system of cylinder 11; or other engine problems affecting cylinder 11.

des: Cylinder 4 - Fuel Trim at Min Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the minimum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Intermediate Shaft Speed Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The main components of the transmission include the planetary gear system located on the intermediate shaft. One end of it is connected to the input shaft and the other end is connected to the output shaft. The causes of failure include the intermediate shaft speed (ISS) sensor, circuit, connector, control module, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 2 Control Circuit High
knowledge: The fan motor controller is responsible for regulating the voltage of the hybrid battery pack cooling fan. If the cooling fan 1 control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit is faulty. The causes of the fault include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Charge Air Cooler Bypass Control B Circuit High
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the air cooler bypass valve control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: TCU Power Input Signal
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, allowing the vehicle to improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel.

des: Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Circuit (Bank 1)
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The causes of the fault include the charge air temperature (CAT) sensor, circuit, connector, control module, etc.

des: Cruise Control Servo Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the cruise control servo is to control the throttle opening according to the instructions of the cruise control module (if the vehicle speed is lower than the set value, the throttle opening is increased; if the vehicle speed is higher than the set value, the throttle opening is reduced), thereby realizing the cruise control function. Fault causes include the cruise control servo, circuit, connector, or cruise control module, etc.

des: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The fuel pressure regulator uses a spring-loaded valve to return excess gasoline to the tank, thereby maintaining constant pressure in the fuel line. There is a vacuum tube on the fuel pressure regulator that is connected to the intake manifold to provide the appropriate gasoline pressure under different engine operating conditions (engine load is determined by the vacuum level). Most cars have the fuel pressure regulator located on the fuel rail, but some cars have the fuel pressure regulator located inside the fuel tank. The fuel pressure sensor is responsible for measuring the fuel pressure near the injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) uses this signal to adjust the injector pulse width and measure the amount of fuel entering the combustion chamber. The electronic control unit (ECU) monitors the reference voltage of the fuel rail pressure sensor. If this voltage is continuously higher than the calibrated maximum value (4.88 volts) for a set period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the heated oxygen sensor heater to ensure that there is no open circuit, short circuit, or excessive current consumption. If the current consumption exceeds the calibrated limit, or an open circuit or short circuit is detected, the fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the oxygen sensor heater circuit, connector failure, oxygen sensor itself failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense Y Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Gear Lever Y Position Circuit Range/Performance
Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit High (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. If the exhaust camshaft adjustment valve circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Phase W Current Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation sensor B, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation A Flow Excessive Detected
knowledge: The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is used to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. At idle, if the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the flow rate of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) is much higher than the value stored during the key-on-engine (KOER) self-test, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include DPFE sensor circuit, connector, or itself, DPFE pipeline failure, EGR valve itself failure or pipeline blockage, electronic control module, etc.

des: Inverter A Cooling System Performance
knowledge: The inverter converts the DC power of the hybrid battery pack into AC power that can be used by MG1 and MG2. In this process, the inverter will release heat, so the inverter has its own cooling system. If this cooling system fails, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid H Electrical
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Drive Motor B Current Sensor Circuit
knowledge: Internal malfunction of the hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve A Circuit
knowledge: When the engine is just started, the secondary air injection system oxidizes harmful gases such as hydrocarbons and carbon monoxide by forcing air into the exhaust manifold. This process also accelerates the warming process of the catalytic converter. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an open or short circuit in the secondary air injection system control solenoid valve circuit, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include an open or short circuit to ground in the secondary air injection actuator circuit, an open or short circuit to ground in the secondary air injection pump circuit, a faulty or leaking switching valve, a faulty relay, or a faulty electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Fuel Pump A Control Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel pump is to suck the fuel from the fuel tank, pressurize it and deliver it to the fuel supply pipe, and cooperate with the fuel pressure regulator to establish a certain fuel pressure. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the fuel pump control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include fuel pressure regulator valve failure, fuel pressure sensor failure, fuel pump control module failure, fuel pump failure, etc.

des: Shift Solenoid G Intermittent
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Diesel Intake Air Flow Control Stuck Open
knowledge: The diesel engine intake flow control system forms an effective intake vortex by automatically controlling the throttle opening angle and coordinating with the tangential airway or spiral airway. At the same time, it automatically controls the intensity of the intake vortex, effectively improving the engine's combustion, thereby optimizing the engine's power, economy and other performance indicators.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor F Circuit High
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 2, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code will appear when the voltage of the heated oxygen sensor signal is continuously higher than 1.5 volts within a set period of time. The causes of the fault include the oxygen sensor signal circuit shorting to the positive pole, the oxygen sensor itself is faulty, and the electronic control module (PCM or ECM) is faulty, etc.

des: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Lean to Rich (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. The first bank refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is the second bank. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that an acceptable voltage change rate is not detected during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from lean to rich, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 9 Glow Plug Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 9 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: High Voltage Service Disconnect Circuit Performance
Starter Relay Circuit High
knowledge: The starter relay (solenoid) works by passing a small current through an electromagnetic coil when the ignition switch is turned on, causing a pair of larger contactors to engage, allowing a large current to pass through the motor and start the engine. This fault code indicates that the starter relay circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The cause of the fault includes the starter, its circuit, connectors, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Cylinder 7 - Injector Leaking
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the fuel injector of cylinder 7 is leaking.

des: Hybrid Battery Precharge Contactor Control Circuit High
knowledge: The System Main Relay (SMR) is responsible for turning the high voltage power supply on and off. If the hybrid vehicle ECU detects a fault in the 1st System Main Relay (SMR1), this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor C Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) sensor signal voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Gear 7 Incorrect Ratio
knowledge: The vehicle was operated with the 7th gear command on and the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detected that the 7th gear ratio was incorrect.

des: Unable to Engage Neutral
B Camshaft Position Slow Response (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft regulating valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. The causes of P000D include the exhaust/right/rear camshaft regulating valve (oil control valve), its circuit, connector, dirty oil or ECU.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 3 Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan to turn on or off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor.
