If the actual battery pack temperature is higher than the battery pack temperature estimated based on the cooling fan performance by a set value, the control module considers that the battery pack fan is faulty or stuck in the off position.

des: Cylinder 9 Injector Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the 9th cylinder injector control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense X Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: A Camshaft Profile Control Performance/Stuck Off (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. This optimizes the efficiency and power of the engine in all speed ranges. This fault code indicates that the A (intake/left/front) camshaft profile control has failed or is stuck in the closed position.

des: Transmission Friction Element C Stuck On
Fuel Pump Primary Circuit
knowledge: The fuel pump circuit is divided into a main circuit and a secondary circuit. The main circuit is responsible for controlling the fuel pump. The fuel pump relay uses a low current from the electronic control unit (ECU) to control the electromagnetic coil, thereby connecting the high current of the fuel pump. The secondary circuit refers to the fuel pump monitor (FPM) circuit, which is responsible for monitoring the circuit feedback of the fuel pump. Fault causes include open or short circuits in the fuel pump (FP) or fuel shut-off valve (FSV) circuits, faults in the fuel pump relay circuit, faults in the fuel pump relay itself, and faults in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Cruise Control Vent Control Circuit High
knowledge: The cruise control system controls the throttle angle and thus the vehicle speed by controlling the vacuum in the servo. When acceleration is required, the vacuum solenoid valve opens and communicates with the intake manifold (or a special vacuum pump), the vacuum in the sealing sleeve increases, sucking the diaphragm, overcoming the spring force, and increasing the throttle opening by pulling the wire, so that the vehicle accelerates. When the set speed is reached, the vacuum solenoid valve and the ventilation solenoid valve are closed at the same time. At this time, the vacuum in the sealing sleeve remains unchanged, and the car maintains a constant speed. When deceleration is required, the ventilation solenoid valve opens to allow air to enter the sealing sleeve, and the diaphragm spring presses the diaphragm back to its original position, the throttle opening decreases, and the car decelerates. P0586 indicates that the voltage of the ventilation control circuit of the cruise control system is higher than the highest calibrated value. The causes of the fault include the cruise control system vent solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The exhaust temperature sensor is used to transmit the exhaust temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. The exhaust temperature produced by the correct air-fuel ratio is lower than the exhaust temperature produced by too rich or too lean air-fuel ratio. Excessive exhaust temperature (>160 degrees Celsius) will damage the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust temperature sensor signal voltage is higher than 4.75 volts (or 2.5 volts) within a set time period (15 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Charge Air Cooler Bypass Control A Range/Performance
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the air cooler bypass valve control A fails, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan Supply Voltage Circuit Low
Internal Control Module Knock Sensor Processor 2 Performance
knowledge: The powertrain control module (PCM) uses a knock sensor to detect vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to avoid knocking. This fault code indicates that the internal control module has a fault.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense A Circuit Low
Clutch Position Sensor Circuit
knowledge: The clutch position sensor transmits information about whether the clutch is depressed in the form of an electrical signal to the electronic control unit, which serves as an important parameter for controlling engine start and cruise control systems.

des: Stuck in Neutral
knowledge: While the vehicle is running, the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the shift solenoid valve is stuck in the open position. The transmission is stuck in neutral. The causes of the fault include the shift solenoid valve, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Manifold Absolute Pressure - Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Sensor A Correlation
knowledge: The function of the Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor is to measure the pressure (vacuum) in the intake manifold. The Powertrain Control Module (PCM) then uses the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (which is linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the basic injection amount of the injector to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. The turbocharger uses the inertial momentum of the exhaust gas discharged from the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to boost the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. The boost sensor, also called the boost pressure sensor (BPS), transmits the boost pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the signal difference between the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor and the turbine/supercharger inlet pressure exceeds the calibrated value (usually 10.35KPa) within a set time period (2.5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Fuel Cooler Pump Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the fuel cooler is to reduce the fuel temperature and thus increase the viscosity of low-sulfur diesel. If there is an error in the fuel cooler pump control circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 11 - Fuel Trim at Min Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the minimum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Shift Solenoid E Control Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

des: Normal/Performance Switch Circuit
knowledge: The function of the transmission mode switch is to instruct the transmission to shift earlier or later, or start in high gear, etc., according to the mode selected by the user (sports/economy/winter, etc.). This fault code indicates that the transmission mode selection switch circuit is faulty.

des: Shift Solenoid A Intermittent
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Drive Motor B Inverter Power Supply Circuit High
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine heat up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage is wrong, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Phase V Current Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

knowledge: The exhaust pressure sensor is used to transmit the exhaust system pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the ECU detects that the exhaust pressure sensor A circuit voltage is out of the normal calibrated range, this fault code will appear.

des: Diesel Intake Air Flow Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The diesel engine intake flow control system forms an effective intake vortex by automatically controlling the throttle opening angle and coordinating with the tangential airway or spiral airway. At the same time, it automatically controls the intensity of the intake vortex, effectively improving the engine's combustion, thereby optimizing the engine's power, economy and other performance indicators.

des: Diesel Intake Air Flow Position Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The diesel engine intake flow control system forms an effective intake vortex by automatically controlling the throttle opening angle and coordinating with the tangential airway or spiral airway. At the same time, the intensity of the intake vortex is automatically controlled, which effectively improves the engine combustion, thereby optimizing the engine power, economy and other performance indicators. The causes of P02E9 include the intake flap control actuator position sensor, its circuit, connector, or control module (ECM).

des: Internal Control Module Torque Calculation Performance
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components.

des: Cruise Control Servo Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the cruise control servo is to control the throttle opening according to the instructions of the cruise control module (if the vehicle speed is lower than the set value, the throttle opening is increased; if the vehicle speed is higher than the set value, the throttle opening is reduced), thereby realizing the cruise control function. This fault code indicates that the servo control circuit of the cruise control system has an error. The causes of the fault include the servo control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Brake Switch B Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the brake switch is to transmit the information of whether the brake pedal is pressed or not to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as an important basis for stopping the cruise control and separating the torque converter.

des: Cylinder 4 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Max Limit
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the compensation learning of the 4th cylinder injector has reached the maximum learning limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cruise Control Input Circuit High
knowledge: The cruise control system allows the driver to automatically maintain the vehicle speed without stepping on the accelerator pedal.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Control Module Feedback Signal
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan Supply Voltage Circuit High
Evaporative Emission System Vent Valve Control Circuit High
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge these gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the EVAP system vent valve control circuit voltage is above the calibrated maximum value.

des: Crankshaft Position Sensor B Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The crankshaft position (CKP) sensor (also called the top dead center sensor) detects the top dead center (TDC) signal, crank angle signal and engine speed signal, and inputs them into the computer, so that the computer can issue the best ignition timing instruction according to the ignition sequence of the cylinders. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the crankshaft sensor B circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation sensor A, this fault code will appear.

des: Engine Mount A Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The electronically controlled suspension of a car can adjust the suspension hardness, damping, and body height according to driving needs to improve the vehicle's form stability and handling. If the control module detects an open circuit in the control circuit of the suspension system, this fault code will appear.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate Solenoid B Range/Performance
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure of the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air of an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the wastegate solenoid valve is to adjust the turbine speed and thus the maximum boost pressure by controlling the exhaust gas flow entering the turbine (bypassing the rest of the exhaust gas). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the wastegate solenoid valve B is faulty, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor H Range/Performance
knowledge: The battery control module controls the opening/closing of the battery fan based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects an error in the battery temperature sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

knowledge: The function of the crankcase pressure sensor is to transmit the pressure in the crankcase to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal to detect the working status of the crankcase forced ventilation system. If the ECU detects a sudden change in the voltage of the crankcase pressure sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. After the engine is shut down for a certain period of time (usually 6 hours), the electronic control unit (ECU) will determine the rationality of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor by comparing the readings of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor with the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor. If the difference between the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor reading and the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor reading exceeds the set calibration value (usually 17°C) when the engine is started next time, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include IAT sensor circuit, connector or itself fault; electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. des: Air Assisted Injector Control Circuit or Circuit Low
knowledge: The air-assisted fuel injector makes the sprayed gasoline mist finer by introducing high-pressure air into the fuel injection passage, thereby optimizing gasoline combustion. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the air-assisted fuel injector control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include failure of the air-assisted fuel injector solenoid valve itself or its circuit, oxygen sensor failure, or powertrain control module (PCM) failure, etc.

des: Motor Electronics Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The Motor Electronics Coolant Temperature (MECT) sensor uses the principle of thermistor to electronically transmit the temperature of the motor electronics coolant to the electronic control unit (ECU). If the control module detects that the Motor Electronics Coolant Temperature (MECT) sensor signal is wrong, this fault code will appear.

des: A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit High

If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor is higher than the calibrated minimum value (4.5 volts), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor failure, circuit short circuit to the positive pole, connector short circuit, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector timing control circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid F Control Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: MAP - Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Correlation
knowledge: The function of the Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor is to measure the pressure (vacuum) in the intake manifold. The Powertrain Control Module (PCM) then uses the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the basic injection amount of the injector to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. If the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) finds that the signal difference between the Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor and the turbo/supercharger inlet pressure sensor (downstream of the throttle valve) exceeds the calibration value (usually 10.35KPa) within a set period of time (2.5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 11 Glow Plug Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 11 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense T Circuit
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense U Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Fuel System Over Pressure Relief Valve Frequent Activation
knowledge: The fuel system needs to maintain a constant pressure. If the oil pressure is too low, the injector will spray too weakly or not at all. If the oil pressure is too high, the oil circuit or injector will be damaged. This fault code indicates that the fuel system is in a state of excessive pressure. To prevent damage to the oil circuit, the overpressure relief valve is frequently activated. Excessive pressure may be caused by problems such as the fuel pressure regulator, oil circuit blockage, fuel pressure sensor, and fuel pump control module.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit High (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage is higher than the maximum value of the self-test (4.6 volts or -50 degrees Celsius), this fault code will appear. Fault causes include sensor circuit short circuit to positive pole, sensor failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Engine Position System Performance (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. The engine position system uses the signals of the crankshaft position sensor and the camshaft position sensor to generate an angle counter. The angle counter is then synchronized with the crankshaft wheel angle to provide the current position of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the two camshafts of the first bank do not match the crankshaft within a certain period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Phase W Current Low
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Up and Down Shift Switch Circuit High
Cylinder 1 Glow Plug Incorrect
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that there is an error in the cylinder 1 glow plug, its circuit, connector, or the glow plug control module (GPCM).

des: Pressure Control Solenoid C Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. The causes of this fault code include the pressure control solenoid valve itself, the circuit, the connector, etc. At the same time, it should be noted that in some cases, the failure of the transmission control solenoid valve is not due to electronic problems, but due to pipeline blockage or mechanical problems. Many times, many such failures are caused simply because the transmission oil is too dirty.

des: Sensor Reference Voltage D Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The electronic control unit (ECU) has detected an error in the 5 volt reference voltage circuit D. The causes of the fault include a short circuit or short circuit from the 5 volt reference voltage circuit to a certain sensor, a short circuit or open circuit in one or more sensors, the ECU, etc.

des: Motor Electronics Coolant Pump B Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The MECS coolant pump is a 12 volt electric pump controlled by the Electronic Control Unit (ECU).

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 3 Control Circuit High
knowledge: The fan motor controller is responsible for regulating the voltage of the hybrid battery pack cooling fan. If the cooling fan 1 control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: DC/DC Converter Temperature Sensor B Circuit
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the HV battery's high DC voltage (200-400 volts) into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle.

des: Mass or Volume Air Flow B Circuit Range/Performance - Air Flow Too Low
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. This fault code indicates that the air flow is too low due to a circuit failure of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor B.

des: Sensor Power Supply B Circuit High
Thermostat Heater Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the thermostat is to close when the coolant temperature is low, allowing only the coolant to circulate in the engine to increase the warm-up speed; when the water temperature exceeds the set temperature, the thermostat opens, allowing the coolant to circulate to the water tank radiator, effectively improving the cooling efficiency. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected that the voltage of the thermostat heater control circuit is out of the normal range of calibration. The cause of the fault includes the thermostat heater, its circuit, connector, relay or electronic control module.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch F Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor E Circuit
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Hydraulic Oil Temperature Sensor Range/Performance
Cylinder 5 - Injector Restricted
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the performance of the 5th cylinder fuel injector is wrong.

des: DC/DC Converter Enable Circuit/Open
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the HV battery's high DC voltage (200-400 volts) into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle.

des: Drive Motor B Position Sensor Circuit
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the drive motor B position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid drive motor; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Shift Timing Solenoid A High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Sensor Power Supply A Circuit/Open
DC/DC Converter Status Circuit Low
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the HV battery's high DC voltage (200-400 volts) into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle. If the DC/DC converter fails, the auxiliary battery voltage will become lower and lower.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense E Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Mass or Volume Air Flow B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, this fault code will appear.

des: Charge Air Cooler Bypass Position Sensor A Circuit Low
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake air temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the voltage of the circuit A of the air cooler bypass valve position sensor is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Park/Neutral Switch Output Circuit
knowledge: The function of the park/neutral position switch is to transmit information about whether the automatic transmission is in park/neutral or other gears to the electronic control unit (ECU) as a reference for determining whether the engine is idling or increasing the load. The switch is also used in the starter relay circuit to prevent the car from starting in gears other than park/neutral.

des: B Camshaft Profile Control Circuit Low (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. This optimizes the efficiency and power of the engine in all speed ranges. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the B (exhaust/right/rear) camshaft profile control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor C Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) sensor signal voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 9 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Max Limit
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the compensation learning of the 9th cylinder injector has reached the maximum learning limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor/Switch High
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the input signal from the EVAP fuel tank pressure sensor to the ECU is higher than the maximum calibrated value (4.50 volts), this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Position Sensor Circuit B Low
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the generator position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid vehicle generator; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Clutch Pedal Switch B Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the clutch pedal switch is to transmit the information of whether the clutch is pressed to the electronic control unit in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as an important parameter for controlling the engine start and cruise control system.

des: Drive Motor A Phase UVW Circuit/Open
Timing Reference High Resolution Signal A Intermittent/Erratic Pulses
knowledge: The optical sensor provides a high-resolution signal to the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) by counting the pulses on the sensor disk located inside the injection pump. This signal is one of the important references for the PCM to control fuel and timing. The causes of this fault code include the optical sensor, its circuit, connector or PCM.

des: TCU Processor
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the vehicle can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. This fault code indicates that the Transmission Control Module has an error.

des: Hybrid Battery A Voltage
Exhaust Pressure Sensor A Circuit Low
knowledge: The exhaust pressure sensor is used to transmit the exhaust system pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the ECU detects that the exhaust pressure sensor A signal circuit voltage is lower than 0.15 volts within a set time period (2.5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery D Voltage Low
A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The function of the air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor is to transmit the temperature inside the air conditioner evaporator to the air conditioner control module in the form of an electrical signal, so that when the temperature inside the air conditioner evaporator is too low, the air conditioner compressor is turned off to prevent the air conditioner evaporator from freezing. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor, this fault code will appear.

des: O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Lean to Rich (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. The first bank refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is the second bank. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that an acceptable voltage change rate is not detected during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from lean to rich, this fault code will appear.

des: Gear Lever X Position Circuit Low
Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate Solenoid A
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the wastegate solenoid valve is to adjust the turbine speed and thus the maximum boost pressure by controlling the exhaust gas flow entering the turbine (bypassing the rest of the exhaust gas). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the wastegate solenoid valve A, this fault code will appear.

des: Injector Circuit/Open - Cylinder 8
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector control circuit, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include injector interface, circuit failure, injector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Transmission Fluid Filter Deteriorated
knowledge: It is recommended to replace the transmission fluid filter.

des: Generator Position Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the generator position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid vehicle generator; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Evaporative Emission System Purge Control Valve Circuit High
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapor from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapor. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapor into the engine combustion chamber. The electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the evaporative emissions system purge control valve control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value. Fault causes include EVAP power supply circuit failure, EVAP solenoid valve control circuit failure, EVAP solenoid valve failure, EVAP carbon canister leakage, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 8 Injection Timing
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the actual timing of the injector deviates from the ideal injection timing by more than the maximum limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Crankshaft Position Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The crankshaft position (CKP) sensor (also called the top dead center sensor) detects the top dead center (TDC) signal, crank angle signal and engine speed signal, and inputs them into the computer, so that the computer can issue the best ignition timing instruction according to the ignition sequence of the cylinders. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the crankshaft sensor A circuit voltage is out of the normal calibrated range, this fault code will appear.

des: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel cut-off valve is to cut off the fuel supply to the engine when the car encounters an emergency (such as rollover). This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the fuel cut-off valve A control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value.

des: Drive Motor A Phase V Current High
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 6 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector circuit of the 6th cylinder, this fault code will appear.

des: Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic (Bank 1)
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The causes of the fault include the charge air temperature (CAT) sensor, circuit, connector, control module, etc.

des: TCU Communication Circuit
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, allowing the vehicle to improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel.

des: Stuck in Gear 7
knowledge: While the vehicle was driving, the electronic control unit (ECU) detected that the shift solenoid valve had failed (stuck), causing the transmission to be stuck in 7th gear. The causes of the failure include the shift solenoid valve, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, control module, and transmission mechanical failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Power Off Circuit Low
knowledge: The hybrid battery power off (BPO) circuit is faulty. The causes of the fault include the BPO circuit and the control module.

des: Battery Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The battery temperature sensor is located at the bottom of the vehicle battery tray. Its main function is to transmit the battery temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal to help determine the charging speed. This fault code indicates that the battery temperature sensor circuit is faulty.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Supply Voltage Circuit High
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the turbo/supercharger boost control B power supply voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value.

des: Cylinder 6 - Fuel Trim at Min Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the minimum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit Low
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the throttle pedal position sensor B circuit voltage is continuously lower than the calibrated minimum value (0.17 volts) within a set period of time. Fault causes include sensor interface failure, circuit short circuit to ground, sensor failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger A Underboost Condition
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the car. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake pressure of an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. To prevent the turbo/supercharger from over-boosting, when the pressure reaches the set maximum value, the air pressure will push the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and reducing the boost level. If the wastegate, wastegate regulating valve, boost bypass valve, boost pressure sensor, etc. fail, it may cause insufficient system boost.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Flow Valve A Control Circuit/Open
Cruise Control Multi-Function Input B Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The cruise control system allows the driver to automatically maintain the vehicle speed without stepping on the accelerator pedal. Faults may include the cruise control multi-function input switch, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Auto Shift Manual Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: Automatic shift manual transmissions allow the driver to put the transmission into manual mode and manually control upshifts or downshifts.

des: Drive Switch Input Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the driving gear position switch is to transmit information about whether the automatic transmission is in the driving gear to the electronic control unit (ECU) as a reference for determining the engine idle speed and increasing the load.

des: Sensor Reference Voltage A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The electronic control unit (ECU) has detected an error in the 5 volt reference voltage circuit A. Causes of the fault include a short circuit or short circuit from the 5 volt reference voltage circuit to a sensor, a short circuit or open circuit in one or more sensors, the ECU, etc.

des: 5-6 Shift
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) commanded a 5-6 gear shift but no corresponding drop in engine speed was detected.

des: Internal Control Module Read Only Memory (ROM) Error
knowledge: An error has occurred in the Electronic Control Unit (ECU). Causes of the error include a failure in the Electronic Control Module (PCM or ECM), an attempt to change the module calibration, an error in module programming, etc. After this fault code appears, delete it first to see if it will reappear. If it reappears soon, in most cases it means that the Electronic Control Module needs to be replaced.

des: Stuck in Gear 5
knowledge: While the vehicle was driving, the electronic control unit (ECU) detected that the shift solenoid valve had failed (stuck), causing the transmission to be stuck in 5th gear. The causes of the failure include the shift solenoid valve, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, control module, and transmission mechanical failure, etc.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch A Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Fuel Pressure Relief Control Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The function of the fuel system overpressure relief valve is to release the fuel line pressure when the fuel line pressure is too high due to a dirty filter, blocked line, etc. If the fuel pressure release control fails or is stuck in the closed position, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery A Voltage Unstable
Charge Air Cooler Bypass Position Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the voltage of the circuit A of the air cooler bypass valve position sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Input/Turbine Speed Sensor A Circuit No Signal
knowledge: The turbine speed sensor (TSS), also called the input shaft speed sensor (ISS), is used to transmit the speed of the input shaft (that is, the torque converter) to the transmission control module (TCU) in the form of frequency. This information is particularly critical for adjusting the torque converter lock clutch. This fault code indicates that the input shaft speed sensor signal is lost. Fault causes include TSS sensor, or its circuit, connector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense Q Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Sensor Reference Voltage B Circuit High
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected an error in the 5V reference voltage circuit B. Causes of the fault include a short circuit or open circuit from the 5V reference voltage circuit to a sensor, a short circuit or open circuit in one or more sensors, an automatic transmission hydraulic sensor fault, a solenoid valve fault, a transmission control module fault, a transmission input speed (RPM) sensor fault, a transmission output speed (RPM) sensor fault, etc.

des: Fuel Injector Control Module Relay Control
knowledge: The fuel injector control module (FICM) is responsible for controlling the injector solenoid valves based on fuel and timing information from the electronic control module (ECU). The electronic control unit (ECU) controls the amount of fuel injected by controlling the injector opening time interval (also called pulse width). P0611 indicates that the fuel injector control module (FICM) relay control is faulty.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Phase UVW Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Generator Position Sensor Circuit A High
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the generator position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid vehicle generator; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Control Module Vehicle Options Error
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and the transmission control module on some vehicles are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor E Circuit Low
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Cruise Control Increase Distance Signal
knowledge: The cruise control system allows the driver to automatically maintain the vehicle speed without stepping on the accelerator pedal. New cars are equipped with intelligent cruise control systems that can set the distance to the car in front. The cause of the malfunction includes the cruise control range control module, circuits, connectors, and electronic control unit.

des: Engine Oil Temperature Sensor Circuit
knowledge: The engine oil temperature (EOT) sensor transmits the oil temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal based on the principle of thermistor. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the oil temperature sensor is out of the calibrated normal range, this fault code will appear. The cause of the fault includes the oil temperature sensor, its circuit, or connector.

des: Hydraulic Pressure Unit Loss of Pressure
Transmission Friction Element A Slip Detected
Generator Inverter Over Temperature
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. This fault code indicates that the generator inverter temperature sensor shows that the temperature is too high. Fault causes include errors in the motor electronic cooling system, low transmission fluid level, and errors in the transmission or transmission control module.

des: Cylinder 9 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector circuit of the 9th cylinder, this fault code will appear.

des: Gear Shift Forward Actuator Circuit Range/Performance
Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense O Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Low (Bank 1 or Single Sensor)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. This fault code indicates that the signal voltage of the A (intake/left/front) camshaft position (CMP) sensor is lower than the calibrated minimum value. The causes of the fault include the camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit, connector, its own fault, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Transmission Friction Element A Stuck On
Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B Position Sensor/Switch Circuit High
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Control Module VSS Output B
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (in some cars, the engine control module and the transmission control module are integrated into a powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal fuel injection amount and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the exhaust emission control components. The function of the vehicle speed sensor (VSS) is to transmit the speed of the car to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for controlling the engine idle speed, automatic transmission shifting, torque converter locking, engine cooling fan opening and closing, and cruise control and other functions.

des: Drive Motor A Current Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: Internal malfunction of the hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Glow Plug Control Module to PCM Communication Circuit
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) loses communication with the glow plug control module (GPCM), or receives a fault message from the GPCM about a CAN bus connection error, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Incorrect Purge Flow
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge these gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chamber. If the evaporative emissions system air purge flow fails, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include exhaust manifold or exhaust pipe leaks, catalytic converter failure itself, engine coolant temperature (ECT) or cylinder head temperature (CHT) sensor failure, engine misfire or ignition timing is too retarded, engine oil is too dirty, front or rear oxygen sensor failure, fuel system pressure is too high, etc.

des: Motor Electronics Coolant Pump A Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The MECS coolant pump is a 12 volt electric pump controlled by the Electronic Control Unit (ECU). This fault code will appear if the control module finds that the MECS coolant pump is forced to ground and there is still a lot of current; or if the MECS coolant pump is not grounded and no voltage is detected.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the drive motor A position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid drive motor; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense D Circuit Low
Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor E Circuit High
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the function of the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor is to transmit the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the electronic throttle position sensor A signal circuit is faulty.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 3 Stuck On
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan to turn on or off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the actual battery pack temperature is lower than the battery pack temperature estimated based on the cooling fan performance by a set value, the control module considers the battery pack fan to be stuck in the on position.

des: HO2S Heater Control Circuit Low (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in which bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the control circuit voltage of the heater is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Control Circuit High (Bank 2)
knowledge: If the length of the intake manifold runner is optimal, the pressure wave generated by the valve closing will help guide the fuel-air mixture into the engine. The problem is that the optimal intake manifold runner lengths for different engine speeds are also different. The function of the manifold tuning valve (MTV) is to guide the intake air into intake manifolds of different lengths according to the engine speed, so as to optimize the engine torque at different speeds. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the intake manifold tuning valve control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value during self-test, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 5 Fuel Injector Offset Learning At Min Limit
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the compensation learning of the 5th cylinder injector has reached the minimum learning limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Idle Air Control System RPM Higher Than Expected
knowledge: The Idle Air Control (IAC) valve has a movable needle valve controlled by a precision moving stepper motor. When the throttle is closed, the IAC valve controls the idle speed by changing the air flow in the bypass line to adapt to the idle speed under different conditions. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the engine idle speed is higher than the set value, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include air leakage after the throttle body, IAC control circuit failure, IAC solenoid valve failure, throttle valve control module failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, vehicle speed sensor failure, etc.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit B Low
HO2S Heater Control Circuit Low (Bank 2, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in which bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the control circuit voltage of the heater is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: B Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Advanced or System Performance (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valve. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. The causes of P0024 include B exhaust/right/rear camshaft timing is not set properly, the camshaft is mechanically stuck, or the actuator valve is stuck in the open position.

des: Drive Switch Input Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the driving gear position switch is to transmit information about whether the automatic transmission is in the driving gear to the electronic control unit (ECU) as a reference for determining the engine idle speed and increasing the load.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B High
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). The electronic control unit (ECU) detected that the voltage of the exhaust pressure control valve A circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The cause of the fault includes the exhaust flap valve or its circuit.

des: Gear Shift Forward Actuator Circuit/Open
Upshift/Skip Shift Solenoid Control Circuit
knowledge: For some high-powered cars, in order to improve the fuel efficiency and reduce emissions, when the conditions are met (low speed, low throttle, car preheated, etc.), the shift solenoid valve will prevent the 2nd and 3rd gears from being engaged, which is equivalent to forcing the gear lever to shift directly from 1st gear to 4th gear. This fault code indicates that the shift solenoid valve control circuit is wrong.

des: Fuel Level Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The fuel level sensor uses a float and variable resistor in the fuel tank to transmit the fuel level in the tank to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the fuel level input signal is out of the calibrated range, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation A Control Position Exceeded Learning Limit
knowledge: The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is used to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants.

des: Thermostat Heater Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the thermostat is to close when the coolant temperature is low, allowing only the coolant to circulate in the engine to increase the warm-up speed; when the water temperature exceeds the set temperature, the thermostat opens, allowing the coolant to circulate to the water tank radiator, effectively improving the cooling efficiency. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the thermostat heater control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value. The cause of the fault includes the thermostat heater, its circuit, connector, or relay.

des: Crankshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The crankshaft position (CKP) sensor (also called the top dead center sensor) detects the top dead center (TDC) signal, crank angle signal and engine speed signal, and inputs them into the computer, so that the computer can issue the best ignition timing instruction according to the ignition sequence of the cylinders. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the crankshaft sensor A circuit voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 12 Injection Timing
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the actual timing of the injector deviates from the ideal injection timing by more than the maximum limit, this fault code will appear.
