des: Drive Motor B Phase V Current Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 1 - Fuel Trim at Max Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the maximum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Charge Air Cooler Coolant Pump Control Circuit High
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. If the voltage of the coolant pump control circuit of the charge air cooler is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: HO2S Heater Control Circuit (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the oxygen sensor does not reach the required temperature within the set time, or the ECU cannot maintain the set temperature, this fault code will appear.

des: Glow Plug Control Module
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that the glow plug control module has a fault. The causes of the fault include the glow plug control module, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Transmission Friction Element E Slip Detected
Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit High
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the signal voltage of the electronic throttle pedal position sensor A is higher than the calibrated maximum value (4.65v). The causes of the fault include the sensor signal circuit short-circuited to the positive pole, the sensor itself is faulty, or the electronic control module (PCM or ECM) is faulty, etc.

des: Fan 3 Control Circuit High
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the Fan 3 (Medium Speed) Control Variable (FCV) circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value. Fault causes include the fan itself or its control circuit, connector, etc.

des: Cylinder 7 Glow Plug Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 7 glow plug control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage System Isolation Fault
knowledge: The hybrid battery voltage system isolation resistance is too low.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate Solenoid A High
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the wastegate solenoid valve is to adjust the turbine speed and thus the maximum boost pressure by controlling the exhaust gas flow entering the turbine (bypassing the rest of the exhaust gas). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the wastegate solenoid valve A circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Phase U Current Low
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Drive Motor B Phase U Current
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the turbo/supercharger boost control circuit is wrong.

des: Shift Solenoid H Stuck On
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 1 - Injector Leaking
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the fuel injector of cylinder 1 is leaking.

des: Throttle Actuator Control Range/Performance (Bank 1)
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the function of the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor is to transmit the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. The throttle actuator is a stepper motor, which is responsible for controlling the throttle opening according to the instructions of the throttle control module. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the throttle actuator control circuit, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include throttle position (TP) sensor failure, throttle valve control module failure, accelerator pedal module failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Negative Contactor Circuit Stuck Open
knowledge: The System Main Relay (SMR) is responsible for turning the high voltage power supply on and off. If the 3rd System Main Relay (SMR) gets stuck, it may cause the high voltage system to not shut down. Therefore, if the hybrid vehicle electronic control unit detects a fault in any of these relays, it will terminate the entire system.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. This fault code indicates that the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage exceeds the calibrated normal value.

des: Intake Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Low (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valve opens and closes at the best time. If the intake camshaft adjustment valve circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Engine Oil Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The engine oil temperature (EOT) sensor transmits the oil temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal based on the principle of thermistor. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the oil temperature sensor, this fault code will appear. The cause of the fault includes the oil temperature sensor, its circuit, or connector.

des: Brake Switch A Circuit
knowledge: The function of the brake switch is to transmit the information of whether the brake pedal is pressed or not in the form of an electrical signal to the electronic control unit (ECU), which serves as an important basis for stopping the cruise control and separating the torque converter. The electronic control unit (ECU) did not find any changes in the brake switch signal during the self-test with the key on and the engine running. The cause of the fault includes the brake light switch, its circuit, or the connector.

des: Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Bank1/Bank2 Correlation
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. If the charge air cooler temperature sensor signals of the first and second rows differ too much, this fault code will appear.

des: Pressure Control Solenoid C Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. The causes of this fault code include the pressure control solenoid valve itself, the circuit, the connector, etc. At the same time, it should be noted that in some cases, the failure of the transmission control solenoid valve is not due to electronic problems, but due to pipeline blockage or mechanical problems. Many times, many such failures are caused simply because the transmission oil is too dirty.

des: Cold Start A Camshaft Position Timing Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valve. When the cold engine is started, if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the A (intake/left/front) camshaft timing exceeds the maximum setting value or is always in the advanced state, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine heat up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the exhaust pressure control valve A circuit voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense W Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Motor Electronics Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The Motor Electronics Coolant Temperature (MECT) sensor uses the principle of thermistor to electronically transmit the temperature of the motor electronics coolant to the electronic control unit (ECU). If the control module detects that the measured motor electronics coolant temperature (MECT) sensor voltage is greater than 5.0 volts, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Vent Valve Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the EVAP system vent valve control circuit voltage is below the calibrated minimum value.

des: Cylinder 12 - Fuel Trim at Max Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the maximum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Actuator Supply Voltage A Circuit/Open
knowledge: The Powertrain Control Module (PCM) has detected that the voltage of the transmission actuator power supply A circuit is out of the normal range. Fault causes include circuit or connector failure, automatic transmission hydraulic sensor failure, solenoid valve failure, transmission control module failure, transmission input speed (RPM) sensor failure, transmission output speed (RPM) sensor failure, etc.

des: Internal Control Module Knock Sensor Processor 1 Performance
knowledge: The powertrain control module (PCM) uses a knock sensor to detect vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to avoid knocking. This fault code indicates that the internal control module has a fault.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor D Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects a sudden change in the voltage of the battery temperature sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 8 Injector Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the 8th cylinder injector control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Supply Voltage Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Charge Air Temperature/Intake Air Temperature Correlation (Bank 1)
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. If the ECU detects that the difference between the charge air temperature sensor and the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal exceeds the set maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor B Circuit High
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

des: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. Fault causes include the throttle flap being too dirty, too sticky, or stuck, the sensor signal circuit being open, the sensor ground circuit being open, or the sensor itself being faulty.

des: Fuel Pressure Regulator 1 - Performance
knowledge: The fuel pressure regulator uses a spring-pushed valve to return excess gasoline to the fuel tank, thereby maintaining a constant pressure in the fuel line. There is a vacuum tube on the fuel pressure regulator that is connected to the intake manifold to provide the corresponding gasoline pressure under different engine operating conditions (the engine load is determined by the vacuum degree). Most cars have fuel pressure regulators located on the fuel distribution pipe, but some cars have fuel pressure regulators located inside the fuel tank. P0089 indicates that the fuel pressure regulator 1 is faulty. Fault causes include fuel pressure regulator valve failure, fuel pressure sensor failure, fuel pump control module (FPCM) failure, fuel pump failure, etc.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit (Bank 2, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) monitors the circuit of the heated oxygen sensor. When the ECU detects a problem with the circuit used to measure the oxygen content in the exhaust gas, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include leakage in the exhaust manifold or exhaust pipe, failure of the oxygen sensor itself or its circuit or connector, and failure of the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense K Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity Detected (Bank 2, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the heated oxygen sensor to determine that the oxygen sensor is working. If the heated oxygen sensor signal value continues to stay at the default value, the electronic control unit (ECU) will command an oscillating air/fuel ratio in an attempt to detect some changes in the signal value. If the ECU still cannot detect changes in the sensor signal at this time, this fault code will appear.

des: Brake Switch A Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the brake switch is to transmit the information of whether the brake pedal is pressed or not in the form of an electrical signal to the electronic control unit (ECU), which serves as an important basis for stopping the cruise control and disengaging the torque converter. The electronic control unit (ECU) found that the voltage of the brake switch circuit is continuously high (stuck in the off position). The cause of the fault includes the brake light switch, its circuit, or the connector.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Coolant Pump Control Circuit/Open
Barometric Pressure Too Low
knowledge: The atmospheric pressure sensor (sometimes called the high altitude compensator, HAC) transmits the atmospheric pressure to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. Atmospheric pressure varies with weather and altitude. The lower the pressure, the thinner the air. The powertrain control module (PCM) corrects the fuel supply based on the atmospheric pressure value to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio. The atmospheric pressure sensor detects that the air pressure is too low. The cause of the malfunction may include the atmospheric pressure sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Heated Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the efficiency of the catalytic converter is lower than the set minimum limit after preheating. The causes of the fault include the catalytic converter, oxygen sensor, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Shift Solenoid C Control Circuit Range/Performance

If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the fuel level input signal is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Cruise Control Off Signal
knowledge: The cruise control system allows the driver to automatically maintain the vehicle speed without pressing the accelerator pedal. During the key-on engine running (KOER) self-test, the electronic control unit (ECU) found that the cruise control OFF key was not pressed. The cause of the malfunction may be the cruise control main switch, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Ambient Air Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent

des: Cold Start B Camshaft Position Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 1)

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch B Circuit Intermittent

des: Glow Plug/Heater Indicator Circuit

The function of the air conditioner clutch relay is to control the separation and engagement of the clutch. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that when the air conditioner clutch relay (A/CCR) control circuit is grounded, it still detects obvious current, or when the air conditioner clutch relay control circuit is not grounded and no voltage is detected, this fault code will appear.

The causes of the fault include the power steering pressure switch, its circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense J Circuit

des: Cruise Control Vent Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The cruise control system controls the throttle angle and thus the vehicle speed by controlling the vacuum in the servo. When acceleration is required, the vacuum solenoid valve opens and communicates with the intake manifold (or a special vacuum pump). The vacuum in the sealing sleeve increases, sucking the diaphragm, overcoming the spring force, and increasing the throttle opening by pulling the wire, so that the vehicle accelerates. When the set speed is reached, the vacuum solenoid valve and the ventilation solenoid valve are closed at the same time. At this time, the vacuum in the sealing sleeve remains unchanged, and the car maintains a constant speed. When deceleration is required, the ventilation solenoid valve opens to allow air to enter the sealing sleeve, and the diaphragm spring presses the diaphragm back to its original position, the throttle opening decreases, and the car decelerates. P0586 indicates that the ventilation control circuit of the cruise control system has an error. The causes of the fault include the cruise control system vent solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor F/G Correlation

des: Input/Turbine Speed Sensor A Circuit Intermittent

This information is particularly critical for adjusting the torque converter lock clutch. This fault code indicates that the TSS sensor signal circuit changes suddenly. Fault causes include TSS sensor, or its circuit connector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

Park/Neutral Switch Input Circuit High

Causes of failure include battery electrode corrosion (causing voltage instability), electronic control module circuit failure, reprogramming failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve control circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor C/D Correlation
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the signal difference of the battery temperature sensor C/D exceeds the maximum limit of calibration, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 11 Injection Timing
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the actual timing of the injector deviates from the ideal injection timing by more than the maximum limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Inverter Over Temperature
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The temperature sensor of the inverter of drive motor B shows that the temperature is too high. The causes of the fault include an error in the motor electronic cooling system, a low transmission fluid level, or an error in the transmission or transmission control module.

des: Injection Pump Fuel Metering Control A (Cam/Rotor/Injector)
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the fuel control actuator (FCA), its circuit, the fuel injection pump, or the electronic control module (ECU). The fuel control actuator (FCA) is usually located on the back side of the fuel injection pump. It is an electronically controlled solenoid valve. The ECU controls the amount of fuel entering the fuel injection pump by cycling the FCA open and closed.

des: Charge Air Cooler Bypass Control B Circuit /Open
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the air cooler bypass valve control circuit fails, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Purge Control Valve Circuit Open
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chamber. This fault code will appear if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an open circuit in the evaporative emissions system purge solenoid valve control circuit. Fault causes include an open circuit in the EVAP power supply circuit, an open circuit or short circuit to ground in the EVAP solenoid valve control circuit, a fault in the EVAP solenoid valve itself, a leak in the EVAP canister, a fault in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM), etc.

des: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The brake booster uses the vacuum generated by the engine intake system (or a dedicated vacuum pump) to assist braking. The brake booster pressure sensor is used to detect the vacuum pressure in the booster. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the brake booster pressure sensor circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Radiator Coolant Temperature/Engine Coolant Temperature Correlation
knowledge: This fault code will appear if the electronic control unit detects that the signal from the (water tank) radiator coolant temperature sensor and the engine coolant (ECT) temperature exceeds the set maximum value.

des: Transmission Park Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit Performance/Low
knowledge: The function of the parking position sensor is to send a signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) indicating whether the gear lever is in the parking position. If the ECU detects an error in the parking position sensor circuit, this fault code will appear.

The causes of the fault include leaks in the exhaust manifold or exhaust pipe, faults in the oxygen sensor itself or its circuit or connector, and faults in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: O2 Sensor Circuit Slow Response (Bank 2, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. When the voltage change rate is lower than the calibration value, the electronic control unit (ECU) will begin to modify the air-fuel ratio and try to increase the voltage change rate of the oxygen sensor. If the ECU has reached the acceptable fuel trim limit or has exceeded the acceptable fuel trim time, and still does not monitor an acceptable voltage change rate, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include oxygen sensor contamination due to silicon in the fuel, open circuit of oxygen sensor signal circuit, oxygen sensor itself failure, exhaust pipe or exhaust manifold leakage, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve A circuit voltage exceeds the calibrated normal value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

The causes of this fault code include the pressure control solenoid valve itself, the circuit, the connector, etc. At the same time, it should be noted that in some cases, the failure of the transmission control solenoid valve is not due to electronic problems, but due to pipeline blockage or mechanical problems. Many times, many such failures are caused simply because the transmission oil is too dirty.

If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected a misfire in cylinder 12. The causes of the fault include ignition system failure, fuel delivery failure, air leakage in the intake manifold or EGR, PCV, mechanical cylinder failure, etc.

The causes of P000A include the intake/left/front camshaft regulating valve (oil control valve), its circuit, connector, dirty oil or ECU.

des: Cylinder 2 - Fuel Trim at Min Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the minimum limit for more than a certain period of time.

When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation B Flow
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. This fault code indicates that the flow rate of exhaust gas recirculation B exceeds the normal range.

des: Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit Low
knowledge: The transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor transmits the transmission fluid temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal based on the principle of thermistor. Its main function is that when the temperature is too high, the transmission control module (TCU) will downshift and slow down. For some new cars, the TCU uses this temperature signal to determine the viscosity of the transmission fluid, thereby adjusting the line pressure and solenoid valve pressure. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor signal voltage is continuously lower than the calibrated minimum value (temperature higher than 157 degrees Celsius), this fault code will appear. Fault causes include TFT sensor circuit open circuit or short circuit to ground, connector failure, TFT sensor calibration imbalance or fault itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: DC/DC Converter Temperature Sensor B Low
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the HV battery's high DC voltage (200-400 volts) into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle.

des: Shift Timing Solenoid A Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Fuel Composition Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel composition sensor is to transmit the ethanol content in gasoline to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal as a basis for modifying the injector pulse width and ignition timing. If the ECU detects that the signal voltage of the fuel composition sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Secondary Air Injection System
knowledge: When the engine is just started, the secondary air injection system oxidizes harmful gases such as hydrocarbons and carbon monoxide by forcing air into the exhaust manifold. This process also accelerates the warming process of the catalytic converter. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the air flow is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Alternative Fuel Control Module RAM/ROM Error
knowledge: Replacement fuel control module failure.

des: Brake Assist Vacuum Too Low
knowledge: The brake booster uses the vacuum generated by the engine's intake system (or a dedicated vacuum pump) to assist braking. The brake booster pressure sensor is used to detect the vacuum pressure in the booster. This fault code indicates that the brake booster pressure sensor detects that the brake booster vacuum is too low.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense M Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense C Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. After the engine is shut down for a certain period of time (usually 6 hours), the electronic control unit (ECU) will determine the rationality of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor by comparing the readings of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor with the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor. If the difference between the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor reading and the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor reading exceeds the set calibration value (usually 17°C) when the engine is started next time, this fault code will appear.

des: Transmission Friction Element A Performance/Stuck Off
Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Intermittent (Bank 1 or Single Sensor)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the A (intake/left/front) camshaft position (CMP) sensor signal is unstable within the set time period, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit Overspeed
knowledge: The drive motor has exceeded the calibrated maximum engine speed limit.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan Sense Circuit High
Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Control Module Internal Temperature Sensor Circuit
knowledge: This fault code indicates that the voltage of the control module's internal temperature sensor signal circuit exceeds the maximum calibrated range. The cause of the fault is the internal temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit/Open
knowledge: The torque converter acts like a clutch in a manual transmission, allowing torque from the engine to be temporarily disconnected from the transmission, allowing for smooth gear changes. However, the difference is that the torque converter can also act as a torque increase, just like downshifting. The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the output of the torque converter clutch (TCC) solenoid valve control circuit is inconsistent with the command output within a specified time period. Causes include TCC actuator control circuit or connector failure, TCC actuator failure, Electronic Control Module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Fuel Temperature Sensor B Circuit Low
knowledge: The fuel temperature sensor is responsible for monitoring the temperature of the fuel leading to the fuel pump to avoid vapor lock caused by excessive temperature (120 degrees Celsius), which may cause damage to the fuel pump or injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the fuel temperature sensor signal voltage. If this voltage is lower than the minimum calibrated value (0.1 volts or 106 degrees Celsius) for a set period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Gear Lever X Position Circuit High
Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor F Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects a sudden change in the voltage of the battery temperature sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 3 - Injector Leaking
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the injector of the 3rd cylinder is leaking.

des: Cylinder 9 Injector Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the 9th cylinder injector control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Isolation Sensor Circuit High
Engine RPM Output Circuit
Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the turbo/supercharger boost control B circuit changes suddenly.

des: Generator Field/F Terminal Circuit Low
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) controls the generator through the generator start signal circuit. When the generator is required to run, the ECU will send a 5V signal to the voltage regulator through the generator start signal circuit. After receiving this signal, the voltage regulator will start to control the generator field circuit. If the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) finds that the generator load is lower than the normal value, this fault code will appear. The most likely possibility is that the generator has no output at all.

des: DC/DC Converter Temperature Sensor A Low
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the HV battery's high DC voltage (200-400 volts) into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle.

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch C Circuit
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Lean to Rich (Bank 2, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. The first bank refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is the second bank. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that an acceptable voltage change rate is not detected during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from lean to rich, this fault code will appear.

des: Hydraulic Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
Mass or Volume Air Flow A Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects that the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value (0.46v), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the sensor signal circuit short-circuited to the positive pole, the sensor itself, or the electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Current Sensor A/B Correlation
A Camshaft Profile Control Stuck On (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. This optimizes the efficiency and power of the engine in all speed ranges. This fault code indicates that the A (intake/left/front) camshaft profile control has failed or is stuck in the open position.

des: DC/DC Converter Temperature Sensor B High
knowledge: The DC/DC converter converts the HV battery's high DC voltage (200-400 volts) into 12 volts, which can be used to charge the auxiliary battery and power accessories in the vehicle.

des: Crankshaft Position Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The crankshaft position (CKP) sensor (also called the top dead center sensor) detects the top dead center (TDC) signal, crank angle signal and engine speed signal, and inputs them into the computer, so that the computer can issue the best ignition timing instruction according to the ignition sequence of the cylinders. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the crankshaft sensor A circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 5 Injection Timing
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the actual timing of the injector deviates from the ideal injection timing by more than the maximum limit, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Phase U Current High
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the generator inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Stuck in Gear 4
knowledge: While the vehicle was driving, the electronic control unit (ECU) detected that the shift solenoid valve had failed (stuck), causing the transmission to be stuck in 4th gear. The causes of the failure include the shift solenoid valve, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, control module, and transmission mechanical failure, etc.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Supply Voltage Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Shift Solenoid C
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor B Circuit
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

des: Transmission Friction Element G Performance/Stuck Off
Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor B Circuit Low
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

des: Cylinder 9 Misfire Detected
knowledge: Cylinder misfire refers to the phenomenon that the mixture cannot burn normally in the cylinder due to various reasons during the operation of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected a misfire in cylinder 9. The causes of the fault include ignition system failure, fuel delivery failure, air leakage in the intake manifold or EGR, PCV, mechanical cylinder failure, etc.

des: Shift Solenoid B
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Timing Reference High Resolution Signal A Too Many Pulses
knowledge: The optical sensor provides a high-resolution signal to the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) by counting the pulses on the sensor disk located inside the injection pump. This signal is one of the important references for the PCM to control fuel and timing. The causes of this fault code include the optical sensor, its circuit, connector or PCM.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 2 Circuit Intermittent/Erratic (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: A/C Refrigerant Charge Loss
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects frequent A/C compressor clutch cycles and infers that the A/C refrigerant is leaking. Causes include A/C cycle pressure switch or its circuit, connector failure, A/C mechanical failure (too little A/C refrigerant, or a broken A/C cycle switch).

des: Motor Torque Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The control module detected that the motor torque sensor signal is outside the normal calibrated range.

des: Drive Motor B Phase V Current Sensor Circuit
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor H Circuit Low
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Inverter Power Supply Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Idle Air Control Circuit
knowledge: The Idle Air Control (IAC) valve has a movable needle valve controlled by a precision moving stepper motor. With the throttle closed, the IAC valve controls the idle speed by varying the air flow in the bypass line to accommodate the idle speed under different conditions. This fault code will appear if the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the Idle Air Control (IAC) valve control circuit is out of the normal range. Causes include IAC control circuit, connector failure, IAC actuator failure, or Electronic Control Module (PCM or ECM) failure.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 2 Circuit Low (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage is lower than the minimum value of the self-test (0.2 volts or 121 degrees Celsius), this fault code will appear.

des: Upshift/Skip Shift Solenoid Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: For some high-powered cars, in order to improve the fuel efficiency and reduce emissions, when the conditions are met (low speed, low throttle, car preheated, etc.), the shift solenoid valve will prevent the 2nd and 3rd gears from being engaged, which is equivalent to forcing the gear lever to shift directly from 1st gear to 4th gear. This fault code indicates that the shift solenoid valve control circuit is wrong.

des: Cylinder 8 Glow Plug Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 8 glow plug control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Engine Speed Input Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: Engine speed (also called input shaft speed) is an important basis for the transmission control module (TCU) to determine gear ratio and shifting, etc. Fault causes include engine speed sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Sense C Circuit Range/Performance
Generator Voltage Sense Circuit
knowledge: The generator voltage monitoring circuit is used to transmit the generator voltage signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) as a reference for controlling the charging speed and determining whether the generator is working properly. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected an error in the generator voltage monitoring circuit. The causes of the fault include the generator voltage monitoring circuit, the generator, or the ECU.

des: Evaporative Emission System High Purge Flow
knowledge: The evaporative emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. This fault code indicates that the evaporative emissions system purge flow rate is too high.

des: Shift Solenoid D Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor F Circuit Low
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects that the battery temperature sensor signal circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Position Sensor Circuit A High
Shift Solenoid G Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Variable A/C Compressor Control Circuit
knowledge: The variable (displacement) air conditioning compressor controls the displacement of the compressor refrigerant being compressed by changing the angle of the splash plate. This fault code indicates that the variable (displacement) air conditioning compressor control circuit is faulty.

des: Unable To Engage Gear 6
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Fan 1 Control Circuit
knowledge: This fault code will appear if the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the low-speed fan control circuit still has significant current consumption when it is grounded (fan on); or when the low-speed fan control circuit is not grounded (fan off) and no voltage is detected.

des: Knock Sensor 2 Circuit Low (Bank 2)
knowledge: The knock sensor is responsible for detecting vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to avoid knocking. If this voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include faults in the knock sensor circuit, loose knock sensor, faults in the knock sensor itself, incorrect fuel grade used, loose engine module parts, and faults in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor/Switch Intermittent
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. If the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects that the fuel tank pressure changes by more than 36 cm of water column within 0.1 seconds, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense Z Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2, Sensor A)
knowledge: The function of the crankshaft is to convert the up and down motion of the piston into rotational motion. The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valve. The electronic control unit (ECU) will continuously monitor the timing position of the variable camshaft and check the relative position between the camshaft and the crankshaft. If the relative position misalignment exceeds 1 gear tooth, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include camshaft position sensor itself or its circuit failure, crankshaft position sensor itself or its circuit failure, engine speed sensor failure, oil contamination, variable camshaft solenoid valve stuck, etc.

des: TCU Power Input Signal Range/Performance
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, allowing the vehicle to improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel.

des: Pressure Control Solenoid C Control Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. The causes of this fault code include the pressure control solenoid valve itself, the circuit, the connector, etc. At the same time, it should be noted that in some cases, the failure of the transmission control solenoid valve is not due to electronic problems, but due to pipeline blockage or mechanical problems. Many times, many such failures are caused simply because the transmission oil is too dirty.

des: Transmission Control System MIL Request Circuit Low
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. If the Transmission Control Module (TCM) detects a fault, it will request the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) to light up the Malfunction Indicator Lamp. The Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL), also known as the Check Engine Light, is used to light up a yellow or red engine symbol on the instrument panel when the control module detects a fault.

des: Cylinder 6 - Fuel Trim at Max Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the maximum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Low
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.
