knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation A Control Stuck Closed
knowledge: The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is used to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the actual exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve position is lower than 15% when the command actual exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve position is higher than 30% within a set time period (4 seconds), the electronic control unit will think that the EGR is stuck in the closed position.

des: Transmission Friction Element F Performance/Stuck Off
Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the throttle pedal position sensor B circuit voltage is out of the normal range of calibration.

des: Cylinder 1 - Injector Restricted
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the performance of the fuel injector of the first cylinder is wrong.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Temperature Sensor B Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation valve (EGR) temperature sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value (4.95 volts) within a set period of time (5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value. Fault causes include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve B Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine heat up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage is wrong, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve Position Sensor/Switch Circuit High
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Manifold Absolute Pressure - Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Sensor B Correlation
knowledge: The function of the Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) sensor is to measure the pressure (vacuum) in the intake manifold. The Powertrain Control Module (PCM) then uses the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (which is linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the basic injection amount of the injector to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. The turbocharger uses the inertial momentum of the exhaust gas discharged from the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to boost the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. The boost sensor, also called the boost pressure sensor (BPS), transmits the boost pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the signal difference between the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor and the turbine/supercharger inlet pressure exceeds the calibrated value (usually 10.35KPa) within a set time period (2.5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger A Overboost Condition
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. To prevent the turbo/supercharger from over-boosting, when the pressure reaches the set maximum value, the air pressure will push the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and reducing the boost level. If the wastegate or wastegate regulating valve fails, it may cause the system to over-boost. Causes of the failure include misfire conditions exceeding the calibrated threshold, knock sensor circuit failure, low-speed fuel pump relay failure, transmission oil temperature exceeding the normal range, and supercharger pressure regulating valve failure.

des: Stuck in Gear 6
knowledge: While the vehicle was driving, the electronic control unit (ECU) detected that the shift solenoid valve had failed (stuck), causing the transmission to be stuck in 6th gear. The causes of the failure include the shift solenoid valve, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, control module, and transmission mechanical failure, etc.

des: Transmission Park Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the parking position sensor is to send a signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) indicating whether the gear lever is in the parking position. If the ECU detects a sudden change in the voltage of the parking position sensor circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 4 - Injector Leaking
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the injector of the 4th cylinder is leaking.

des: Secondary Air Injection System Control A Circuit
knowledge: When the engine is just started, the secondary air injection system (AIR) oxidizes the hydrocarbons, carbon monoxide and other harmful gases by forcing air into the exhaust manifold. This process also accelerates the warming process of the catalytic converter. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an open circuit or short circuit in the secondary air injection system control solenoid valve circuit, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include secondary air injection system actuator circuit failure, AIR bypass solenoid valve circuit failure, AIR pump control circuit failure, valve failure, solid-state relay failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Closed Throttle Position Switch
knowledge: The purpose of the closed throttle position switch (sensor) is to indicate whether the throttle is fully closed. The causes of the P0510 fault code include the closed throttle position switch (sensor), throttle position (TP) sensor (TPS), or throttle valve control module (TVCM).

des: Stuck In Reverse
knowledge: While the vehicle is driving, the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the shift solenoid valve is faulty (stuck), causing the transmission to be stuck in reverse gear. The causes of the fault include the shift solenoid valve, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, control module, and transmission mechanical failure, etc.

des: Cylinder 3 - Injector Restricted
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the performance of the 3rd cylinder fuel injector is wrong.

des: Transmission Friction Element E Performance/Stuck Off
Cylinder 3 Injector Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the circuit of the 3rd cylinder injector, this fault code will appear.

des: Gear 5 Incorrect Ratio
knowledge: The vehicle is running with the 5th gear command on, and the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the 5th gear ratio is incorrect. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, shift solenoid valve, transmission hydraulic sensor, solenoid valve failure in the valve body, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, transmission control module failure, etc.

des: Intake Air Heater A Circuit High
knowledge: The intake air heater, also called the manifold intake air heater, is used to preheat the intake air to help the diesel engine start easily in cold weather. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the manifold intake air heater circuit (MIAH) circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Voltage Sense Circuit High
knowledge: The generator voltage monitoring circuit is used to transmit the generator voltage signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) as a reference for controlling the charging speed and determining whether the generator is working properly. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected an error in the generator voltage monitoring circuit. The causes of the fault include the generator voltage monitoring circuit, the generator, or the ECU.

des: Power Steering Pressure Sensor/Switch Circuit
knowledge: The power steering pressure (PSP) sensor transmits the power steering load pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal based on the principle of a potentiometer. If the load pressure is too large, the ECU will increase the engine idle speed and shut down the air conditioning compressor if necessary to prevent the engine from stalling. This fault code indicates that the power steering pressure sensor circuit is faulty.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The causes of the fault include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor A Circuit Low
knowledge: The fuel pressure regulator uses a spring-loaded valve to return excess gasoline to the tank, thereby maintaining constant pressure in the fuel line. There is a vacuum tube on the fuel pressure regulator that is connected to the intake manifold to provide the appropriate gasoline pressure under different engine operating conditions (engine load is determined by the vacuum level). Most cars have fuel pressure regulators located on the fuel rail, but some cars have the fuel pressure regulator located inside the fuel tank. The fuel pressure sensor is responsible for measuring the fuel pressure near the injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) uses this signal to adjust the injector pulse width and measure the amount of fuel entering the combustion chamber. The electronic control unit (ECU) monitors the reference voltage of the fuel rail pressure sensor. If this voltage is continuously below the calibrated minimum value (0.49 volts) for a set period of time, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include fuel pressure regulator valve failure, fuel pressure sensor failure, fuel pump control module failure, fuel pump failure, etc.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air for an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing the output power. The function of the turbo/supercharger boost controller is that when the boost pressure reaches the set value, the air pressure pushes the wastegate actuator (pneumatic mechanical type) to bypass part of the exhaust gas from the turbine, thereby reducing the turbine speed and controlling the boost level. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the turbo/supercharger boost control A circuit changes suddenly.

des: Ignition Coil G Primary/Secondary Circuit
knowledge: The function of the ignition coil is to convert the 12 volt voltage of the car battery into thousands or even tens of thousands of volts required for spark plug ignition. There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include ignition start/run circuit, ignition coil circuit, ignition coil itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Pressure Control Solenoid A Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The shift solenoid controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its disengagement and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. Fault causes include the pressure control (PC) solenoid valve circuit, connector, or the solenoid valve itself. A control module fault may also cause this fault code to appear.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve Position Sensor/Switch Circuit
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve position sensor signal voltage exceeds the calibrated normal value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Precharge Contactor Circuit
knowledge: The System Main Relay (SMR) is responsible for turning the high voltage power supply on and off. If the hybrid vehicle ECU detects a fault in the 1st System Main Relay (SMR1), this fault code will appear.

des: Starter Disable Circuit/Open
knowledge: The causes of this fault code include: 1) starter lock circuit failure; 2) parking gear/neutral gear signal output circuit failure; 3) ECU/TCU circuit failure.

des: Fuel Level Sensor A Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The fuel level sensor uses a float and variable resistor in the fuel tank to transmit the fuel level in the tank to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. The electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the fuel level input signal.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense I Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: MAP - Mass or Volume Air Flow Correlation (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor is to measure the pressure (vacuum) in the intake manifold. The powertrain control module (PCM) will then use the difference between the intake manifold pressure and the atmospheric pressure (which is linearly related to the engine load) as a basis for determining the basic injection amount of the injector to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio under different loads. The function of the air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the injection amount. If the ECU finds that the load estimated by the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor and the air flow (MAF) sensor is too different, this fault code will appear.

des: Glow Plug Sense Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the glow plug monitoring circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Transmission Park Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the parking position sensor is to send a signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) indicating whether the shift lever is in the parking position. If the ECU detects that the parking position sensor circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Motor Electronics Coolant Pump B Control Circuit High
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The MECS coolant pump is a 12 volt electric pump controlled by the Electronic Control Unit (ECU).

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor C Circuit
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Park Input Circuit
HO2S Heater Resistance (Bank 1, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the number of oxygen sensors in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code indicates that the current of the heated oxygen sensor heater control circuit is too low or too high.

des: Shift Solenoid H Control Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Engine Speed Input Circuit No Signal
knowledge: Engine speed (also called input shaft speed) is an important basis for the transmission control module (TCU) to determine gear ratio and shifting. During engine operation, the electronic control unit (ECU) or transmission control module (TCU) does not detect the engine speed input signal on the CAN high-speed transmission network. Fault causes include engine speed sensor, circuit, connector, sensor wheel failure, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 2)
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to pressurize the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The causes of this fault code include problems with the charge air cooler temperature sensor, its circuit, or connector.

des: Immobilizer Lamp Control Circuit
knowledge: The function of the anti-theft control module is to ensure that the car will not be allowed to start unless the special key exists and it matches various components.

des: Cylinder 6 Injector Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the injector control circuit of the 6th cylinder is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Four Wheel Drive (4WD) Switch Circuit
Motor Electronics Coolant Pump B Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The MECS coolant pump is a 12 volt electric pump controlled by the Electronic Control Unit (ECU).

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Coolant Pump Control Circuit Low
Unable To Engage Gear 5
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

des: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 2 Circuit Intermittent/Erratic (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor is to transmit the engine's intake air temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal, providing a reference for injection correction. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor signal voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit (Bank 1 or Single Sensor)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. This fault code will appear when the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the A (intake/left/front) camshaft position (CMP) sensor signal cannot be detected within the set time period. The causes of the fault include the camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit, connector, its own fault, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Cylinder 11 Misfire Detected
knowledge: Cylinder misfire refers to the phenomenon that the mixture cannot burn normally in the cylinder due to various reasons during the operation of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected a misfire in cylinder 11. The causes of the fault include ignition system failure, fuel delivery failure, air leakage in the intake manifold or EGR, PCV, mechanical cylinder failure, etc.

des: Engine Speed Input Circuit
knowledge: Engine speed (also called input shaft speed) is an important basis for the transmission control module (TCU) to determine gear ratio and shifting, etc. Fault causes include engine speed sensor, circuit, connector, transmission control module (TCM) failure, engine control module failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects a sudden change in the voltage of the battery temperature sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Clutch Pedal Switch A Circuit
knowledge: The function of the clutch pedal switch is to transmit the information of whether the clutch is pressed to the electronic control unit in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as an important parameter for controlling the engine start and cruise control system.

des: Cylinder 10 - Injector Restricted
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the fuel injector opening. This fault code indicates that the performance of the 10th cylinder fuel injector is wrong.

des: Cylinder 3 Glow Plug Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a fault in the cylinder 3 glow plug circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Diesel Intake Air Flow Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The diesel engine intake flow control system forms an effective intake vortex by automatically controlling the throttle opening angle and coordinating with the tangential airway or spiral airway. At the same time, the intensity of the intake vortex is automatically controlled, which effectively improves the engine combustion, thereby optimizing the engine power, economy and other performance indicators. The causes of P02EA failure include the intake flap control actuator position sensor, its circuit, connector, or control module (ECM).

des: Generator Field/F Terminal Circuit
knowledge: The causes of the fault include faults in the generator field control circuit or connector, loose generator belt, generator regulator fault, fault in the generator itself, or fault in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM), etc.

des: Transmission Mode Switch B Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the transmission mode switch is to instruct the transmission to shift earlier or later, or start in high gear, etc. according to the mode selected by the user (sports/economy/winter, etc.). Fault causes include the transmission mode switch, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: Cylinder 9 - Fuel Trim at Min Limit
knowledge: Fuel trimming refers to the electronic control unit (ECU) controlling fuel delivery by increasing or decreasing the time the injectors are open to achieve the best air-fuel ratio (14.7:1 air-to-gasoline mass ratio) for the engine. Too rich an air-fuel ratio means too much fuel is delivered, and too lean an air-fuel ratio means too little fuel is delivered. This fault code will appear if fuel trim reaches and stays at the minimum limit for more than a certain period of time.

des: Fuel Pressure Sensor B Circuit
knowledge: The fuel pressure regulator uses a spring-loaded valve to return excess gasoline to the tank, thereby maintaining constant pressure in the fuel line. There is a vacuum tube on the fuel pressure regulator that is connected to the intake manifold to provide the appropriate gasoline pressure under different engine operating conditions (according to the vacuum level to determine the engine load). Most cars have the fuel pressure regulator located on the fuel rail, but some cars have the fuel pressure regulator located inside the fuel tank. The fuel pressure sensor is responsible for measuring the fuel pressure near the injector. The electronic control unit (ECU) uses this signal to adjust the injector pulse width and measure the amount of fuel entering the combustion chamber. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the fuel pressure sensor signal voltage exceeds the normal calibration value for a set period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Inverter Temperature Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Hybrid Battery D Voltage Unstable
Brake Switch A Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the brake switch is to transmit the information of whether the brake pedal is pressed or not in the form of an electrical signal to the electronic control unit (ECU), which serves as an important basis for stopping the cruise control and disengaging the torque converter. The electronic control unit (ECU) found that the voltage of the brake switch A circuit is continuously very low (stuck in the open position). The cause of the fault includes the brake light switch, its circuit, or the connector

des: Injection Pump Fuel Metering Control A Intermittent (Cam/Rotor/Injector)
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the fuel control actuator (FCA), its circuit, the fuel injection pump, or the electronic control module (ECU). The fuel control actuator (FCA) is usually located on the back side of the fuel injection pump. It is an electronically controlled solenoid valve. The ECU controls the amount of fuel entering the fuel injection pump by cycling the FCA open and closed.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense T Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Temperature Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation valve (EGR) temperature sensor, this fault code will appear.

des: Incorrect Gear Ratio
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) monitors the actual gear position by checking the torque converter slip ratio calculated by the Transmission Control Module (TCU). If the actual gear position is higher than the TCU desired position, the slip ratio will be higher than normal. If the slip ratio is higher than a set value, this fault code will appear.

des: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit Intermittent (Bank 1 or Single Sensor)
knowledge: The knock sensor is responsible for detecting vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to prevent knocking. If this voltage changes suddenly, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor of a hybrid vehicle is located inside the battery assembly. The causes of this fault code include the hybrid battery (intake air temperature (IAT) sensor), battery pack control module, etc.

des: Generator Temperature Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The starter/generator of a hybrid vehicle is the same motor, usually located in the transmission. Causes of failure include the generator temperature sensor, circuit, connector, control module, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense Y Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Transmission Mode Switch A Circuit
knowledge: The function of the transmission mode switch is to instruct the transmission to shift earlier or later, or start in high gear, etc. according to the mode selected by the user (sports/economy/winter, etc.). Fault causes include the transmission mode switch, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation valve (EGR) temperature sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value (4.95 volts) within a set period of time (5 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 12 Injector Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the 12th cylinder injector control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Knock Control System Error
knowledge: The powertrain control module (PCM) uses a knock sensor to detect vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to avoid knocking. If the signal of the knock sensor exceeds the measurement range, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include faults in the knock sensor circuit, loose knock sensor, faults in the knock sensor itself, incorrect fuel grade used, loose engine module parts, and faults in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Auto Shift Manual Control Circuit
knowledge: Automatic shift manual transmissions allow the driver to put the transmission into manual mode and manually control upshifts or downshifts.

des: A Camshaft Profile Control Circuit/Open (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. This optimizes the efficiency and power of the engine in all speed ranges. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the A (intake/left/front) camshaft profile control circuit exceeds the calibrated normal range for a period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: High Voltage System Interlock Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the high voltage system interlock is to close the system main relay when the vehicle is stationary if there is a problem with the safety device (for example, the charging connector or converter is not covered). If the control module detects a fault in the high voltage interlock circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid H Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Temperature Sensor C Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan on/off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the battery control module detects a sudden change in the voltage of the battery temperature sensor signal circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Fuel Rail/System Pressure - Too Low
knowledge: The fuel system needs to maintain a constant pressure. If the oil pressure is too low, the injector will spray too weakly or not at all. If the oil pressure is too high, the oil circuit or injector will be damaged. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the fuel supply pipe pressure is lower than the calibrated minimum value within a set period of time. Low pressure may be caused by problems such as the fuel pump, fuel pump control module, fuel pressure regulator, fuel pressure sensor, fuel leakage, etc.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor C Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) sensor signal voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Inverter Performance
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the generator pulse width modulation (PWM) circuit. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Internal Control Module Non-Volatile Random Access Memory (NVRAM) Error
knowledge: Internal control module failure

des: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors the heated oxygen sensor heater to ensure that there is no open circuit, short circuit, or excessive current consumption. If the current consumption exceeds the calibrated limit, or an open circuit or short circuit is detected, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include an open circuit in the oxygen sensor heater voltage circuit or an open circuit in the heater ground circuit, signal crossover caused by oil or moisture in the connector, a fault in the oxygen sensor itself, and a fault in the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Gate Select Position Circuit Low
knowledge: Door select position (monitors shift lever left/right position) circuit fault.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense C Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Cylinder 5 Contribution/Balance
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the crankshaft acceleration contribution of the 5th cylinder is lower than the calibrated value. Fault causes include the 5th cylinder injection system; or other engine problems affecting the 5th cylinder.

des: PCM/ECM/TCU Internal Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The engine control module, also called the engine control unit (the engine control module and transmission control module on some cars are integrated into the powertrain control module), controls the operation of the entire engine. Its most important function is to control the optimal amount of fuel injection and ignition timing of the engine. Another important function is to monitor the components responsible for exhaust emission control. The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the engine control module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, so that the car can improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the temperature sensor signal circuit inside the control module is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The cause of the fault is the internal temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit is faulty. The causes of the fault include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation B Control Stuck Open
knowledge: The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is used to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the command exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve position is lower than 15% within the set time period (4 seconds), and the actual EGR valve position exceeds 30%, the electronic control unit will think that the EGR is stuck in the open position.

des: Drive Motor A Phase U Current
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Mass or Volume Air Flow A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects an error in the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the mass air flow (MAF) sensor circuit, connector, or itself; electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor transmits the transmission fluid temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal based on the principle of thermistor. Its main function is that when the temperature is too high, the transmission control module (TCU) will downshift and slow down. For some new cars, the TCU uses this temperature signal to determine the viscosity of the transmission fluid, thereby adjusting the line pressure and solenoid valve pressure. If the ECU detects that the transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor signal voltage is out of the normal range, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include transmission fluid level is too low or too dirty, transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor or its circuit connector failure, transmission fluid temperature (TFT) sensor calibration error, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Motor Electronics Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The Motor Electronics Cooling System (MECS) is an independent system that provides cooling for the transmission (e.g. eCVT) motor, control module and DC/DC converter. It has its own radiator, coolant pump, coolant temperature sensor, etc. The Motor Electronics Coolant Temperature (MECT) sensor uses the principle of thermistor to electronically transmit the temperature of the motor electronics coolant to the electronic control unit (ECU). If the control module detects that the measured motor electronics coolant temperature (MECT) sensor voltage changes suddenly in a short period of time, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense A Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Charge Air Cooler Bypass Position Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the air cooler bypass valve position sensor A fails, this fault code will appear.

des: Pressure Control Solenoid A
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. The causes of this fault code include failure of the pressure control (PC) solenoid valve circuit, connector, or solenoid valve itself. Control module failure may also cause this fault code to appear.

des: Engine Overspeed Condition
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the engine speed has exceeded the calibrated maximum limit. Fault causes include the engine running in the wrong gear, the engine running at high speed in neutral, and the wheels spinning at high speed on wet or snowy ground.

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation A Control Stuck Open

Fuel Pressure Relief Control Circuit High

des: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch F Circuit Intermittent

The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Catalyst Heater Control Circuit (Bank 1)

des: Single Cylinder Misfire (Cylinder not Specified)
knowledge: Cylinder misfire refers to the phenomenon that the mixture cannot burn normally in the cylinder due to various reasons during the operation of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that an unspecified cylinder has misfired.

des: Gear 6 Incorrect Ratio
knowledge: The vehicle is running with the 6th gear command on, and the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the 6th gear ratio is incorrect. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, shift solenoid valve, transmission hydraulic sensor, solenoid valve failure in the valve body, input shaft speed sensor, output shaft speed sensor, circuit, connector, transmission control module failure, etc.

des: Crankcase Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the crankcase pressure sensor is to transmit the pressure in the crankcase to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal to detect the working status of the crankcase forced ventilation system. This fault code indicates that the ECU has detected a fault in the crankcase pressure sensor circuit.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense E Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Main Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2)

It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the efficiency of the main catalytic converter is lower than the set minimum limit. The causes of the fault include the catalytic converter, oxygen sensor, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense R Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The exhaust temperature sensor is used to transmit the exhaust temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. The exhaust temperature produced by the correct air-fuel ratio is lower than the exhaust temperature produced by too rich or too lean air-fuel ratio. Excessive exhaust temperature (>160 degrees Celsius) will damage the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust temperature sensor signal voltage is lower than 0.1 volts (or 0.2 volts) within a set time period (15 seconds), this fault code will appear.

des: Low Pressure Fuel System Pressure - Too Low, Low Ambient Temperature

The camshaft-driven high-pressure fuel pump can pressurize gasoline to a maximum of 1900psi. The fuel system needs to maintain a constant pressure. If the oil pressure is too low, the injector will spray too weakly or not at all. If the oil pressure is too high, the fuel line will be damaged or the injector will be damaged. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected that the fuel pressure is too low. Low pressure may be caused by problems such as the fuel pump, fuel pump control module, fuel pressure regulator, fuel pressure sensor, fuel leak, etc.

If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 3 glow plug circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.
