If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 7 glow plug control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor/Switch Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the oil pressure sensor is to transmit the oil pressure to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. If the pressure is insufficient, the ECU will issue an alarm signal on the instrument panel. This fault code indicates that the oil pressure sensor/switch circuit is faulty.

des: Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate Solenoid B
knowledge: A turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to increase the intake pressure of the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the vehicle. A supercharger is an air compressor used to increase the intake air of an internal combustion engine. More intake air provides more oxygen to the engine, allowing the control module to provide more fuel, thereby increasing output power. The function of the wastegate solenoid valve is to adjust the turbine speed and thus the maximum boost pressure by controlling the exhaust gas flow entering the turbine (bypassing the rest of the exhaust gas). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the wastegate solenoid valve B is faulty, this fault code will appear.

des: Thermostat Heater Control Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the thermostat is to close when the coolant temperature is low, allowing only the coolant to circulate in the engine to increase the warm-up speed; when the water temperature exceeds the set temperature, the thermostat opens, allowing the coolant to circulate to the water tank radiator, effectively improving the cooling efficiency. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the thermostat heater control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The cause of the fault includes the thermostat heater, its circuit, connector, or relay.

des: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detection Reference Orifice High Flow
knowledge: The EVAP system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chambers. The purpose of the Leak Diagnostic Module is to apply a small pressure to the EVAP system and the fuel system using the Leak Detection Pump (LDP), and then test the system for leaks to ensure that no harmful vapors escape into the atmosphere. This fault code indicates that the EVAP leak detection system has failed.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a sudden change in the exhaust pressure control valve A circuit voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Inverter Phase W Over Temperature
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Output Speed Sensor Circuit No Signal
knowledge: The task of the output speed sensor (OSS) is to transmit the speed signal of the transmission output shaft to the electronic control unit (ECU). If the ECU cannot detect the OSS signal, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include interference of non-standard accessories on the OSS sensor, failure of the OSS sensor itself, circuit or connector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: A/C Clutch Relay Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The air conditioner pulley just idles when the air conditioner is turned off. Only when the air conditioner clutch (under the action of the solenoid valve) is engaged, will the compressor be driven to operate. The function of the air conditioner clutch relay is to control the separation and engagement of the clutch. When the air conditioner clutch is commanded to be closed, the electronic control unit (ECU) does not detect voltage on the air conditioner relay control circuit.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor B Circuit Low (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. This fault code indicates that the signal voltage of the electric B (exhaust/right/rear) camshaft position (CMP) sensor is lower than the calibrated minimum value. The causes of the fault include the camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit, connector, its own fault, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve A Circuit Low
knowledge: The exhaust pressure control valve is a variable position valve. Its main function is to help the engine warm up quickly by changing the exhaust pressure (boosting engine load) when the outside temperature is extremely low (<5 degrees Celsius). If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the exhaust pressure control valve A circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter temperature sensor circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value. Fault causes include catalytic converter temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or electronic control unit (ECU) failure.

des: Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor F Circuit High
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The temperature sensor circuit of the drive motor B is faulty. The causes of the fault include the circuit, connector, electronic control unit, drive motor, etc. The drive motor temperature sensor of some vehicles is integrated with the drive motor. Therefore, if it is determined that the problem is with the temperature sensor itself, it may be necessary to replace the entire drive motor.

des: Cylinder 3 Glow Plug Incorrect
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that there is an error in the cylinder 3 glow plug, its circuit, connector, or the glow plug control module (GPCM).

des: Pressure Control Solenoid B Performance/Stuck Off
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. Fault causes include the pressure control solenoid valve control circuit, connector, or the solenoid valve itself. A control module fault will also cause this fault code to appear.

des: Timing Reference High Resolution Signal B No Pulses
knowledge: The optical sensor provides a high-resolution signal to the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) by counting the pulses on the sensor disk located inside the injection pump. This signal is one of the important references for the PCM to control fuel and timing. The causes of this fault code include the optical sensor, its circuit, connector or PCM.

des: Injector Circuit/Open - Cylinder 7
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector control circuit, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include injector interface, circuit failure, injector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Fuel Level Sensor A Circuit
knowledge: The fuel level sensor uses a float and variable resistor in the fuel tank to transmit the fuel level in the tank to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. If the ECU finds that the fuel level reading remains unchanged despite obvious fuel consumption, this fault code will appear.

des: Generator Torque Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The control module has detected that the generator torque sensor signal is outside the normal calibrated range.

des: Cylinder 7 Misfire Detected
knowledge: Cylinder misfire refers to the phenomenon that the mixture cannot burn normally in the cylinder due to various reasons during the operation of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected a misfire in cylinder 7. The causes of the fault include ignition system failure, fuel delivery failure, air leakage in the intake manifold or EGR, PCV, mechanical cylinder failure, etc.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense G Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Alternative Fuel Control Module KAM Error
knowledge: Replacement fuel control module failure.

des: Mass or Volume Air Flow A Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects that the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is lower than the calibrated minimum value (0.23v), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include leakage in the intake pipe, open circuit of the sensor power supply circuit, open circuit of the sensor signal circuit, and fault of the MAF sensor itself.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense M Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Drive Motor B Position Sensor Circuit Overspeed
knowledge: The drive motor has exceeded the calibrated maximum engine speed limit.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Control Module Internal Temperature Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: This fault code indicates that the voltage of the control module's internal temperature sensor signal circuit exceeds the maximum calibrated range. The cause of the fault is the internal temperature sensor, circuit, connector, or control module.

des: 14 Volt Power Module Current Sensor Circuit Intermittent
High Voltage System Interlock Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the high voltage system interlock is to close the system main relay when the vehicle is stationary if there is a problem with the safety device (for example, the charging connector or converter is not covered). If the control module detects a fault in the high voltage interlock circuit, this fault code will appear.

des: Injection Pump Fuel Metering Control B High (Cam/Rotor/Injector)
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the fuel control actuator (FCA), its circuit, the fuel injection pump, or the electronic control module (ECU). The fuel control actuator (FCA) is usually located on the back side of the fuel injection pump. It is an electronically controlled solenoid valve. The ECU controls the amount of fuel entering the fuel injection pump by cycling the FCA open and closed.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit B
Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch A Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: High Voltage Service Disconnect Circuit Low
Variable A/C Compressor Control Circuit High
knowledge: The variable (displacement) air conditioning compressor controls the displacement of the compressor refrigerant compressed by changing the angle of the splash plate. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the variable (displacement) air conditioning compressor control circuit is higher than the calibrated maximum value.

des: Cylinder 8 Contribution/Balance
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the crankshaft acceleration contribution of cylinder 8 is lower than the calibrated value. Causes of the fault include the injection system of cylinder 8; or other engine problems affecting cylinder 8.

des: Cylinder 7 Contribution/Balance
knowledge: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) has detected that the crankshaft acceleration contribution of cylinder 7 is lower than the calibrated value. Fault causes include the injection system of cylinder 7; or other engine problems affecting cylinder 7.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Current Sensor A Circuit High
knowledge: The battery control module monitors the charge and discharge of the battery through the signal from the battery current sensor. If the control module finds that the battery current sensor signal circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hydraulic Pressure Sensor Circuit
Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The exhaust temperature sensor transmits the exhaust temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal. The exhaust temperature produced by the correct air-fuel ratio is lower than the exhaust temperature produced by an overly rich or lean air-fuel ratio. Excessive exhaust temperature (>160 degrees Celsius) can damage the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that the exhaust temperature sensor changes by less than 40 degrees Celsius 10 minutes after the engine is cold started, this fault code will appear.

des: Cylinder 8 Glow Plug Incorrect
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. This fault code indicates that there is an error in the cylinder 8 glow plug, its circuit, connector, or the glow plug control module (GPCM).

des: Drive Motor A Phase V Current Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
Heated Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the catalytic converter efficiency is lower than the set minimum limit after preheating. The causes of the fault include the catalytic converter, oxygen sensor, circuit, connector, etc. The causes of the fault include exhaust gas leakage near the exhaust pipe or exhaust manifold, catalyst box failure, engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor failure, engine misfire or timing lag, dirty oil, oxygen sensor failure, and too high fuel system pressure.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Supply Voltage Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Fan Speed Low
Cylinder 3 Glow Plug Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the glow plug is to heat the compressed gas in the diesel engine combustion chamber through the electric heating coil, so that the diesel engine can be started easily in cold weather. The glow plug control module can automate the preheating and cycling process of the glow plug. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the cylinder 3 glow plug circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery System Voltage High
Charge Air Cooler Bypass Control A Circuit Low
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the temperature of the charge air, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the air cooler bypass valve control circuit voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Charge Air Cooler Bypass Control A Stuck
knowledge: The turbocharger uses the inertial force of the exhaust gas discharged by the engine to drive the turbine, which in turn drives the coaxial impeller to supercharge the intake air, thereby increasing the power of the car. The charge air cooler (also called the intercooler) is used to cool the supercharged air coming out of the supercharger. After the air passes through the supercharger, the pressure increases and the temperature rises. The charge air cooler can reduce the charge air temperature, thereby increasing the air density and the charging efficiency, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing engine power and reducing emissions. The function of the charge air cooler bypass valve is to bypass part of the air around the air cooler. This air is then mixed with the air cooled by the air cooler and enters the engine to ensure that the intake air temperature is higher than the dew temperature. If the air cooler bypass valve control A is stuck, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense J Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Fuel Timing Error
knowledge: This fault code appears when the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the injector timing or the difference between the actual fuel pressure and the ideal fuel pressure is out of the calibrated normal range. The cause of the fault may include the injector, its circuit, connector, or the fuel injector control module (FICM).

des: Fuel Injector Driver Circuit Performance (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the injector driver circuit is short-circuited to ground or short-circuited to the positive pole, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense X Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Stuck On
knowledge: The battery control module controls the battery fan to turn on or off based on the signal from the battery temperature sensor. If the actual battery pack temperature is lower than the battery pack temperature estimated based on the cooling fan performance by a set value, the control module considers the battery pack fan to be stuck in the on position.

des: Hybrid Battery Precharge Contactor Circuit Stuck Open
knowledge: The System Main Relay (SMR) is responsible for turning the high voltage power supply on and off. If the hybrid vehicle ECU detects a fault in the 1st System Main Relay (SMR1), this fault code will appear.

des: Clutch Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The clutch position sensor transmits information about whether the clutch is depressed in the form of an electrical signal to the electronic control unit, which serves as an important parameter for controlling engine start and cruise control systems.

des: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit A
Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 3 Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The battery pack fan motor controller is responsible for regulating the voltage of the hybrid battery pack cooling fan. If the cooling fan 1 control circuit voltage exceeds the normal range of the target voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Low
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the signal voltage of the electronic throttle pedal position sensor A is lower than the calibrated minimum value (0.17v). Fault causes include open circuit of the sensor signal circuit, short circuit of the sensor signal circuit to ground, open circuit of the sensor reference voltage circuit, fault of the sensor itself, or fault of the electronic control module (PCM or ECM).

des: Injector Circuit/Open - Cylinder 3
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects an error in the injector control circuit, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include injector interface, circuit failure, injector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Up and Down Shift Switch to Transmission Range Correlation
Generator Inverter Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: 14 Volt Power Module System Voltage Low
Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch C Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: In the electronic throttle control (ETC) system, the accelerator pedal position (APP) sensor transmits the position of the accelerator pedal to the throttle control module in the form of an electrical signal, which serves as a reference for the throttle actuator to control the throttle valve opening. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the throttle pedal position sensor C circuit changes suddenly.

des: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code will appear when the voltage of the heated oxygen sensor signal is continuously higher than 1.5 volts within a set period of time. The causes of the fault include the oxygen sensor being contaminated by silicon in the fuel, the signal crossing due to oil or moisture in the connector, the sensor signal circuit shorting to the positive pole, the sensor itself failing, and the electronic control module, etc.

des: Ignition Coil D Primary/Secondary Circuit
knowledge: The function of the ignition coil is to convert the 12 volt voltage of the car battery into thousands or even tens of thousands of volts required for spark plug ignition. There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include ignition start/run circuit, ignition coil circuit, ignition coil itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Drive Switch Input Circuit
knowledge: The function of the driving gear position switch is to transmit information about whether the automatic transmission is in the driving gear to the electronic control unit (ECU) as a reference for determining the engine idle speed and increasing the load.

des: Hybrid Battery Pack Cooling Fan 2 Control Circuit/Open
knowledge: The battery pack fan motor controller is responsible for regulating the voltage of the hybrid battery pack cooling fan. If the cooling fan 2 control circuit voltage exceeds the normal range of the target voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Hydraulic Pressure Sensor Circuit Low
Battery Temperature Sensor Circuit High
knowledge: The battery temperature sensor is located at the bottom of the vehicle battery tray. Its main function is to transmit the battery temperature to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal to help determine the charging speed. If the ECU detects that the battery temperature sensor circuit voltage is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Solenoid D Control Circuit High
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Fuel Pump Control Module
knowledge: The fuel pump control module (FPM, or FPCM) is a computer microprocessor that controls the voltage to the fuel pump (usually located in the fuel tank) to achieve the optimal fuel pressure required by the electronic control module (ECU). The causes of P064A include the fuel pump control module, circuits, connectors, or electronic control unit (ECU).

des: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor B Circuit High
knowledge: The function of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system is to introduce a small amount of exhaust gas into the intake manifold when the engine is running at high load. The presence of these exhaust gases reduces the temperature and pressure of the combustion chamber, thereby reducing the emission of nitrogen oxide pollutants. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Shift Timing Solenoid A Range/Performance
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Shift Solenoid G
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Injection Pump Fuel Metering Control B (Cam/Rotor/Injector)
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the fuel control actuator (FCA), its circuit, the fuel injection pump, or the electronic control module (ECU). The fuel control actuator (FCA) is usually located on the back side of the fuel injection pump. It is an electronically controlled solenoid valve. The ECU controls the amount of fuel entering the fuel injection pump by cycling the FCA open and closed.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense Z Circuit
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Cruise Control Servo Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the cruise control servo is to control the throttle opening according to the instructions of the cruise control module (if the vehicle speed is lower than the set value, the throttle opening is increased; if the vehicle speed is higher than the set value, the throttle opening is reduced), thereby realizing the cruise control function. This fault code indicates that the voltage of the cruise control system servo control circuit is lower than the calibrated minimum value. The causes of the fault include the servo control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, etc.

des: Drive Motor B Current High
HO2S Heater Control Circuit High (Bank 2, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in which bank. Bank 1 refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is bank 2. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The electronic control unit (ECU) maintains the temperature of the oxygen sensor at 780oC by controlling the on/off of the oxygen sensor heater. If the control circuit voltage of the heater is higher than the calibrated maximum value, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor B Inverter Power Supply Circuit/Open
knowledge: The function of an inverter is to convert direct current into alternating current.

des: Cylinder 7 Injector Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the fuel injector is to atomize the fuel so that it meets the requirements of combustion. The working principle is that when the electromagnetic coil is energized, suction is generated, the needle valve is sucked up, the spray hole is opened, and the fuel is sprayed out at high speed through the annular gap between the needle pin at the head of the needle valve and the spray hole to form a mist. The electronic control unit controls the injection amount by controlling the time interval (also called pulse width) of the injector opening. If the voltage of the injector control circuit of the 7th cylinder is lower than the calibrated minimum value, this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include the injector control circuit, connector, or the injector itself; injector control module (FICM).

des: Transmission Control System (MIL Request)
knowledge: The transmission control module (TCM or TCU) helps the transmission decide when and how to shift gears by collecting information from various sensors and the engine control module to improve vehicle performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel. The malfunction indicator light (MIL), also known as the check engine light, illuminates a yellow or red engine symbol on the instrument panel when the control module detects a fault. This fault code indicates that the powertrain system (ECU) has received a request from the transmission control unit (TCU) to illuminate the malfunction indicator light.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor B Circuit (Bank 2)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the voltage of the camshaft sensor B circuit is out of the normal range of calibration, this fault code will appear.

des: Pressure Control Solenoid C Intermittent
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the pressure control solenoid valve is to control the pressure of the transmission fluid. Fault causes include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or control module, etc.

des: Ignition Coil I Primary/Secondary Circuit
knowledge: The function of the ignition coil is to convert the 12 volt voltage of the car battery into thousands or even tens of thousands of volts required for spark plug ignition. There are two sets of coils in the ignition coil, the primary coil and the secondary coil. The primary coil has thicker enameled wire and fewer turns; the secondary coil uses thinner enameled wire and has relatively more turns. When the primary coil is connected to the power supply, a strong magnetic field is generated around it as the current increases, and the iron core stores the magnetic field energy; when the switch device disconnects the primary coil circuit, the magnetic field of the primary coil decays rapidly, and the secondary coil will induce a high voltage. The electronic control unit (ECU) continuously monitors each ignition main circuit. If the ECU does not receive a valid ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) pulse signal from the ignition module (integrated in the ECU), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include ignition start/run circuit, ignition coil circuit, ignition coil itself, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: TCU Communication Circuit High
knowledge: The Transmission Control Module (TCM or TCU) collects information from various sensors and the Engine Control Module to help the transmission decide when and how to shift gears, allowing the vehicle to improve performance, shift smoothly, and save fuel.

des: Fan Rationality Check
knowledge: This fault code will appear if the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the fan speed is close to zero, or the fan clutch is stuck.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense X Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Gear Shift Lock Solenoid/Actuator Control Circuit A Range/Performance
Control Module Programming Error
knowledge: An electronic control unit (ECU) error. Causes include vehicle identification (VID) data block error when reprogramming with a scan tool, battery electrode corrosion (causing voltage instability), electronic control module circuit failure, reprogramming failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Lean to Rich (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the bank. The first bank refers to the bank where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining bank is the second bank. Regardless of which bank, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). The heated oxygen sensor monitor tracks the voltage change rate during the rise and fall of the oxygen sensor signal. If the electronic control unit (ECU) finds that an acceptable voltage change rate is not detected during the process of the air-fuel ratio changing from lean to rich, this fault code will appear.

des: Ignition/Distributor Engine Speed Input Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The causes of the fault include engine speed sensor failure, sensor wheel failure or mismatch, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Gear Shift Lock Solenoid/Actuator Control Circuit A/Open
Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor/Switch
knowledge: The Evaporative Emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chamber. This fault code appears due to a problem with the fuel tank pressure sensor range (compensation). The fuel tank pressure sensor output is compensated to plus or minus 4.3 cm of water column. If the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects that the fuel tank pressure changes by more than 36 cm of water column within 0.1 seconds, this fault code will appear.

des: Gear Lever Y Position Circuit
Internal Control Module Keep Alive Memory (KAM) Error
knowledge: An error has occurred in the electronic control unit (ECU). External factors, such as power supply, may also cause this fault code. Causes include circuit failure from KAM to the electronic control module, corrosion or poor contact of the battery terminals, reprogramming errors, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: System Voltage Too Low for Voltage Step Down Conversion
Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch H Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. Accurate control of the transmission fluid pressure is very important for smooth gear shifting. The function of the transmission fluid pressure (TFP) sensor is to transmit the transmission fluid pressure in the form of an electrical signal to the transmission control module (TCU) as a reference for the operation of the transmission fluid pressure control solenoid valve.

des: Drive Motor A Control Module
knowledge: An internal fault has occurred in the motor control module (MCM). Possible causes include the MCM processor, analog-to-digital converter, power supply voltage, serial communication, etc.

des: TCU Engine Speed Output Circuit Low
knowledge: Engine speed (also called input shaft speed) is an important basis for TCU to determine gear ratio and shifting, etc.

des: Generator Position Sensor Circuit B Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The causes of the fault include the generator position sensor circuit, connector, or sensor itself; hybrid vehicle generator; hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Drive Motor A Position Exceeded Learning Limit
Drive Motor Inverter Temperature Sensor C Circuit Low
knowledge: The inverter converts DC power into AC power. The hybrid electronic control unit (HV ECU) uses a temperature sensor integrated in the inverter to monitor the temperature of the drive motor inverter. If the output of this temperature sensor is abnormal, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense P Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor is to transmit the temperature inside the air conditioner evaporator to the air conditioner control module in the form of an electrical signal, so that when the temperature inside the air conditioner evaporator is too low, the air conditioner compressor is turned off to prevent the air conditioner evaporator from freezing. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects that the signal voltage of the air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor is lower than the calibrated minimum value (0.13 volts), this fault code will appear. The causes of the fault include air conditioner evaporator temperature sensor failure, circuit short circuit to ground, connector failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Stalled
knowledge: The function of the transmission fluid pump is to provide working pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is running. The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and combination, thereby achieving gear shifting. The function of the auxiliary transmission fluid pump is to provide pressure to the transmission fluid when the engine is not running (such as when towing) to prevent the transmission from overheating.

des: Drive Motor B Phase V Current Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Radiator Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
knowledge: The (water tank) radiator coolant temperature sensor uses the principle of thermistor to transmit the radiator temperature signal to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of voltage. If the ECU detects a sudden change in the (water tank) radiator coolant temperature sensor signal voltage, this fault code will appear.

des: Drive Motor A Current Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: Internal malfunction of the hybrid vehicle electronic control unit (HV ECU).

des: Catalyst Heater Control Circuit (Bank 2)
knowledge: The catalytic converter (also known as the catalytic purification converter) is an exhaust purification device that uses the action of a catalyst to convert CO, HC and NOx in the exhaust into gases that are harmless to the human body. It is generally located before the muffler of the exhaust pipe. This fault code indicates that the electronic control unit (ECU) has detected a fault in the catalytic converter heater circuit.

des: Mass or Volume Air Flow A Circuit Intermittent
knowledge: The function of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor is to convert the air flow into an electrical signal and send it to the electronic control unit (ECU) as one of the basic signals for determining the amount of fuel injection. If the ECU detects a sudden change in the signal voltage of the mass air flow (MAF) sensor, this fault code will appear.

des: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the instructions from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. If the actual position of the B (exhaust) camshaft differs from the ideal position by more than 20 degrees, this fault code will appear.

des: Hybrid Battery C Voltage Unstable
Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
knowledge: Cylinder misfire refers to the phenomenon that the mixture cannot burn normally in the cylinder due to various reasons during the operation of the engine. If the electronic control unit (ECU) detects a misfire that may damage the catalytic converter, the fault indicator light will flash and the engine should be turned off immediately. This fault code indicates that multiple cylinders have misfired or the electronic control unit (ECU) cannot determine which cylinder has misfired. Causes of the fault include mechanical failure of the cylinder, fuel metering error, too high or too low fuel pressure, evaporative emission system failure, EGR valve stuck open, PCV system vacuum leak, ignition system failure, air flow meter failure, and low fuel level in the fuel tank.

des: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense N Circuit Low
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor transmits the temperature of the engine coolant to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of an electrical signal through the principle of thermistor, which is used as a basis for correcting injection and ignition. If P0116 appears, it means that the reading of the coolant temperature sensor exceeds the calibrated maximum value (usually 107 degrees Celsius) when the engine is started, or is higher than the reading of the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor by a certain value (usually 17 degrees Celsius). Fault causes include low coolant level, incorrect sensor calibration, or sensor failure.

des: Hybrid Battery Positive Contactor Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The System Main Relay (SMR) is responsible for turning the high voltage power supply on and off. If the Hybrid ECU detects a fault in the 2nd System Main Relay (SMR), this fault code will appear.

des: Barometric Pressure - Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Correlation
knowledge: The atmospheric pressure sensor (sometimes called the high altitude compensator, HAC) is used to transmit the atmospheric pressure to the electronic control module in the form of an electrical signal. Atmospheric pressure varies with weather and altitude. The lower the pressure, the thinner the air. The powertrain control module (PCM) will correct the fuel supply according to the atmospheric pressure value to help the engine achieve the best air-fuel ratio. This fault code indicates that the signal difference between the atmospheric pressure sensor and the turbo/supercharger inlet pressure sensor (downstream of the throttle valve) exceeds the calibration value (usually 10.35KPa) within a set period of time (2.5 seconds).

des: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 2, Sensor 3)
knowledge: The function of the oxygen sensor is to measure the oxygen content in the engine exhaust to correct the injection amount so that the engine can obtain the best air-fuel ratio. In the OBD fault code, you will often see the oxygen sensor in the row. The first row refers to the row where cylinder 1 is located, and the remaining row is the second row. Regardless of which row, the first sensor always refers to the upstream oxygen sensor (before the catalyst box), and the second sensor always refers to the downstream oxygen sensor (after the catalyst box). This fault code will appear when the voltage of the heated oxygen sensor signal is continuously lower than 156 millivolts within a set period of time. The causes of the fault include oxygen sensor contamination due to silicon in the fuel, oxygen sensor signal and ground circuit crossover, oxygen sensor signal circuit short circuit to ground, oxygen sensor itself failure, electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure, etc.

des: Shift Solenoid B Control Circuit Low
knowledge: The shift solenoid valve controls the hydraulic pressure to the transmission clutch by opening or closing the transmission fluid control valve to control its separation and engagement, thereby achieving gear shifting. The causes of this fault code include low transmission fluid level, dirty transmission fluid, mechanical failure of the shift solenoid valve, circuit, connector, or transmission control module (TCM) failure, etc.

des: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit High (Bank 1 or Single Sensor)
knowledge: The function of the camshaft is to control the opening and closing of the valves. In the variable valve timing system, the electronic camshaft adjustment valve (or oil control valve, OCV) adjusts the angle of the camshaft according to the command from the engine control module (ECM) by changing the oil pressure to the camshaft adjuster (mechanical type) to ensure that the valves open and close at the best time. The function of the camshaft position (CMP) sensor is to transmit the camshaft position (relative position of the valve) to the electronic control unit (ECU) in the form of a voltage signal. This fault code indicates that the signal voltage of the A (intake/left/front) camshaft position (CMP) sensor is higher than the calibrated maximum value. The causes of the fault include the camshaft position (CMP) sensor circuit, connector, its own fault, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) fault, etc.

des: Auto Configuration Throttle Input Not Present
Fan Speed High
Hybrid Battery Voltage Sense F Circuit Range/Performance
knowledge: The function of the hybrid battery voltage monitoring circuit is to transmit the battery block voltage to the control module to monitor the charging and discharging of the battery block, as well as possible short circuits and open circuits.

des: Diesel Intake Air Flow Control System - Low Air Flow Detected
knowledge: The diesel engine intake flow control system forms an effective intake vortex by automatically controlling the throttle opening angle and coordinating with the tangential air channel or spiral air channel. At the same time, it automatically controls the intensity of the intake vortex, effectively improving the engine combustion, thereby optimizing the engine power, economy and other performance indicators. P02ED indicates that the electronic control module (ECM) detects a too low intake flow rate.

des: Knock Sensor 2 Circuit (Bank 2)
knowledge: The knock sensor is responsible for detecting vibrations when the engine speed changes. The knock sensor then expresses this vibration in the form of voltage. When necessary, the electronic control module (ECU) will delay the ignition to avoid knocking. If this voltage is out of the calibration range, this fault code will appear. Fault causes include faults in the knock sensor circuit, connector, itself, or electronic control module (PCM or ECM) failure.

des: Drive Motor B Phase W Current Sensor Circuit Low
knowledge: The Hybrid Vehicle Electronic Control Unit (HV ECU) is responsible for monitoring the drive motor inverter current sensor. If the HV ECU detects an error, this fault code will appear.

des: Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor/Switch Range/Performance
knowledge: The Evaporative Emissions (EVAP) system directs gasoline vapors from the fuel tank into a tank containing activated carbon that absorbs the gasoline vapors. The engine then uses fresh air to purge the gasoline vapors into the engine combustion chamber. This fault code appears due to a problem with the fuel tank pressure sensor range (compensation). The fuel tank pressure sensor output is compensated to plus or minus 4.3 cm of water column. If the Electronic Control Unit (ECU) detects that the fuel tank pressure changes by more than 36 cm of water column within 0.1 seconds, this fault code will appear.
